description:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $11B - multiples of 11, always.
We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

About the role

We are looking for freelance Transcription and Subtitling Specialists to join our fast-growing Productions team. Productions is a new marketplace that brings together our AI audio tools and a network of human experts to unlock high-quality, human-edited transcripts, subtitles, dubs, audiobooks, and more at scale for our users and customers. While Productions is just getting started, we already manage content workflows for some of the world's top YouTube channels, book publishers, and media & entertainment businesses.

Here's what you can expect in our team:

  • Producing and reviewing highly accurate transcripts for a range of exciting content

  • Creating high-quality subtitles for video content following specific formatting rules and timing standards

  • Competitive task-based compensation

  • Flexible workload and scheduling - claim and complete jobs directly on our platform

Requirements

  • Native or near-native fluency in one or more supported languages

  • Prior experience in transcription or subtitling and familiarity with relevant tools

  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to linguistic accuracy

  • Ability to work independently and deliver high-quality work on time

Bonus:

  • Experience using the ElevenLabs platform and/or other AI-assisted transcription and subtitling tools, subtitle editors, or captioning software

  • Previous work with language service providers, localization teams, or media companies

  • Background in linguistics, language technology, or media production

Location

This role is remote and can be executed globally.

description:
At Aristocrat, our mission is to bring happiness to life through the power of play. As a global leader in gaming content and technology, we continue to invest in innovative products and the future of play. As the Senior Manager, Digital Product Portfolio, you will help drive and mature our Digital portfolio management capabilities across Interactive and Product Madness. Reporting to the Senior Director, Product Operations & Portfolio, you'll collaborate with Product, Commercial, Finance, Technology, and Business Unit leaders to align roadmaps, commercial priorities, investment choices, portfolio performance, and business goals into a unified portfolio perspective. Your insights will assist leaders in evaluating tradeoffs, prioritizing opportunities, and making informed decisions that support portfolio success and sustained growth.

What You'll Do

  • Drive portfolio visibility, planning, and governance activities across the Digital portfolio.
  • Partner with Product, Commercial, Finance, Technology, and Business Unit partners to align priorities, investment decisions, capacity plans, and commercialization strategies.
  • Develop and maintain integrated portfolio views that highlight product performance, roadmap priorities, critical initiatives, portfolio composition, and growth opportunities.
  • Lead prioritization, sequencing, and tradeoff discussions that support investment and prioritization decisions.
  • Identify opportunities, risks, dependencies, gaps, and concentration concerns, and suggest actions that support portfolio health and growth.
  • Develop insights, scenarios, and decision-support materials that assist leaders in evaluating options and making informed decisions.
  • Establish and evolve portfolio management frameworks, taxonomy, reporting standards, and planning processes that improve consistency and transparency.
  • Improve tools, dashboards, reporting, and data access to increase visibility and support decision-making across the Digital business.
  • Analyze portfolio performance, market trends, and emerging opportunities to inform future planning and investment decisions.
  • Build alignment across stakeholders by providing clear portfolio insights, recommendations, and decision-ready materials.

What We're Looking For

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Product Management, Finance, Marketing, Analytics, or a related area; equivalent experience will also be taken into account.
  • 8+ years of experience in product operations, portfolio management, product management, long-term planning, business operations, program management, or a related function.
  • Experience working with complex digital product, content, platform, or technology portfolios in a highly cross-functional environment.
  • Understanding of Digital gaming businesses, including Social, RMG, iLottery, mobile gaming, or related digital product environments.
  • Ability to connect product, commercial, financial, market, and operational inputs into clear portfolio insights and practical recommendations.
  • Demonstrated experience supporting planning, prioritization, sequencing, investment, and portfolio tradeoff discussions with senior leadership.
  • Analytical and structured problem-solver, comfortable working through complex, evolving, and distributed information.
  • Skilled at coordinating portfolio-related work, managing competing priorities, and keeping alignment across functions.
  • Strong collaborator management skills with the ability to influence without direct authority and build credibility across diverse teams.
  • Clear communicator who can translate complex portfolio information into concise, executive-ready recommendations and materials.
  • Proficient with Microsoft 365 tools, including Excel, PowerPoint, Teams, SharePoint, and Power BI; actively interested in bringing to bear AI / Copilot to improve portfolio analysis, planning, reporting, and decision support.

This job description may have been reviewed and enhanced using AI-assisted tools to improve clarity, consistency, and inclusivity. All final content, role requirements and hiring decisions remain subject to human review and approval by Aristocrat.

Compensation Philosophy

We offer a comprehensive pay and benefits package designed to stay competitive in the market, support your wellbeing, and recognise your contribution to our success. Our approach is underpinned by a pay-for-performance belief in rewarding individual impact. Your specific compensation package will be determined by factors such as your skills, experience, qualifications, and location.

Depending on your role and location, you may be eligible for annual bonuses and incentives, health and wellbeing benefits, paid time off, retirement plans, insurance coverage, and other local or statutory benefits.

Specific details about compensation and benefits for this position will be discussed during the recruitment process.

title: Product Support Engineer - EMEA
location: Czechia,  Denmark,  France,  Germany,  Ireland,  Italy,  Netherlands,  Poland,  Portugal,  Romania,  Spain,  Sweden,  UK
description:
Hello!

I’m Allie, Head of Support at Ashby. I’m excited to share that we’re hiring a Product Support Engineer in EMEA

We’re expanding our global Support team to provide 24/7 coverage across time zones. You’ll join a global team while establishing the technical Support Engineering presence in EMEA, with the ownership and visibility that come from being one of the first Support Engineers across European time zones. We staff across regions rather than relying on on-call rotations; we’ll discuss the specific schedule for this opening during the process.

Not sure which Support role is right for you?

We’re hiring for both Product Support Specialist and Product Support Engineer roles.

  • Support Specialist owns cases and customer communication end-to-end. Troubleshoots complex issues by navigating internal tooling — audit logs, user experience testing, and API testing — to help customers reach successful outcomes.

  • Support Engineering serves as the escalation point between Support Specialists and Product Engineering. Owns integrations, supports data mapping and data migrations for customers, and resolves escalated tickets that don't require product code changes.

Please choose the role that best reflects your experience and interests rather than applying to both. If another Support role seems like a closer match, we’ll consider that in our review.

About the role

Support Engineering is the technical layer between frontline Support and Engineering. You’ll take on complex issues involving integrations, APIs, permissions, data, reporting, migrations, and workflows—using application behavior, logs, databases, and customer context to determine whether an issue can be resolved through Support or represents a product defect.

You’ll investigate issues end to end using tools such as Plain, GitHub, Datadog, databases, and the codebase. You won’t write the fix; you’ll give Engineering a well-validated escalation with reproduction steps, relevant evidence, customer impact, and a root-cause hypothesis when possible. You’ll also identify recurring issues, improve documentation and enablement, and partner with Product and Engineering on improvements. As an early Support Engineer in EMEA, you’ll establish regional operating practices and handoff norms across European time zones while bringing EMEA customer patterns to a global team.

What you’ll own

  • Own complex technical issues from intake through resolution or escalation—investigating APIs, integrations, logs, data, configuration, and workflows to determine whether Support can resolve them or Engineering should be involved.

  • Set a high bar for complex technical investigations and ensure Engineering receives clear, actionable, well-validated product issues.

  • Build trusted working relationships with frontline Support, Engineering, Product, Customer Success, and customers.

  • Identify recurring problems and turn them into documentation, enablement, tooling, process improvements, or product feedback.

  • Partner with Product and Engineering on recurring product improvements by synthesizing customer patterns, validating defects, and sharing the technical context needed to choose between a product change, documentation, tooling, or process improvement.

  • Establish EMEA coverage, handoff, and operating practices across European time zones while bringing regional customer patterns to the global Support Engineering team.

  • Track and improve the outcomes that matter: resolution speed, escalation quality, fewer avoidable Engineering escalations, frontline self-sufficiency, reduced customer effort, and customer confidence.

You should apply if:

  • You’ve worked in a hands-on, customer-centric technical role where you independently investigate ambiguous issues involving APIs, integrations, logs, data, and application behavior.

  • You’re comfortable moving between customer conversations, APIs, logs, databases, product behavior, and code-level context to find root causes.

  • You can distinguish a configuration, data, documentation, or enablement issue from a true product defect—and explain your reasoning clearly.

  • You write precise investigations that others can quickly understand and act on, and communicate thoughtfully with technical and non-technical audiences across time zones.

  • You naturally look beyond the immediate ticket and improve the systems around it through documentation, enablement, tooling, or process design.

  • You want to be an early technical owner for EMEA and are energized by building regional structure within a global team.

You should not apply if:

  • You’re looking primarily for a high-volume support role centered on predefined troubleshooting steps, rather than open-ended technical investigation and ownership.

  • Most of your experience is in internal IT, help desk, endpoint, hardware, network, infrastructure, cloud operations, systems administration, infrastructure maintenance, or service deployment—and you haven’t worked extensively with customer-centric SaaS applications, APIs, logs, or data-backed troubleshooting.

  • You prefer to pass difficult issues to another team rather than reproduce, investigate, and explain them yourself.

  • You’re looking for a role focused mainly on writing production code; this role diagnoses and escalates bugs but does not own code changes.

  • You prefer clear-cut problems and predefined answers over working through ambiguity with careful documentation, focused questions, and evidence-based decisions.

  • You want a narrowly defined role without regional operating ownership or projects that improve how the broader Support team works.

About Ashby

Ashby builds a suite of products that helps talent leaders, recruiters, and hiring managers run their hiring process significantly better. We raised a $50M Series D in July 2025 and support nearly 5,000 customers, including Shopify, Snowflake, OpenAI, Deliveroo, and Confluent. We’re growing much faster than 100% year over year, with a team of roughly 300 people across 22+ countries. Learn more at ashbyhq.com.

About Go To Market

We view our Support team as an extension of the product itself, one that ensures an optimal customer experience for customers ranging across all market segments. Here are a few points that should give you an idea of what it is like to work with us:

  • We spend a lot of time building best-in-class products since we believe a highly differentiated product is easier to sell.

  • We also spend a lot of time building a best-in-class customer experience. We aim to offer deep expertise whenever we interact with prospects and customers.

  • We strongly believe that small teams with very talented people and the right work environment deliver much better performance than teams with large headcount.

We value a strong sense of ownership, principled thinking over experience, and thoughtful communication (we put a lot of effort into using the right communication channels) - we’ll get into these and other values during the hiring process. You can take a look at our Leadership Principles to get a sense of what we value in People Leaders at Ashby.

Interview process

Our interview process is thorough and designed to give you enough information to assess whether Ashby is the right fit for you, while helping us evaluate technical reasoning, communication precision, and ownership.

  • Intro call with Recruiting — 30 min

  • Take-home assessment — 5 days to complete

  • Hiring Manager interview — 45–60 min

  • Virtual onsite — 120 min

    • Meet the team — 30 min

    • Technical & integration skills — 45 min

    • CS and Support leadership — 30 min

    • Closing questions — 15 min

Onboarding

Your onboarding will combine Ashby-wide product and company training with a Support Engineering-specific ramp plan. You’ll learn the product and support workflow, get familiar with the tools and systems used for technical investigations, and build relationships across Support, Product, and Engineering. With support from your manager and onboarding buddy, you’ll take on increasingly complex investigations as you build context, with regular check-ins throughout your first 90 days.

Benefits

Benefits vary by country and are shared in more detail during the process. International employees receive statutory benefits and, where available, employer-paid supplemental health coverage.

  • 10-year exercise window for stock options. You shouldn’t feel pressure to purchase stock options if you leave Ashby —do it when you feel financially comfortable.

  • Unlimited PTO. Expect “Vacation?” in our one-on-one agenda until you start taking it

  • A $1,200 annual learning and professional-development budget.

  • A one-time $2,000 home-office setup budget for furniture, monitors, peripherals, and ergonomic equipment, plus a company-provided laptop.

  • Opportunities to spend time with teammates through an annual company offsite, team offsites, local meetups, and virtual events.

  • Extended health benefits for you and your dependents (subject to availability with our Employer of Record)

Ashby provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression. We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities.

Ashby is committed to a fair and transparent hiring process. We confirm that this advertisement is for an active, existing vacancy within our organization. Please be advised that we may use artificial intelligence-driven tools to assist our recruitment team in screening, assessing, and selecting candidates for this position.

title: Organic & AI Search Manager
description:
What do we do?

Paddle offers digital product companies a completely different approach to their payment infrastructure. Instead of assembling and maintaining a complex stack of payments-related apps and services, we’re a Merchant of Record for our customers. That means we take away 100% of the pain of payment fragmentation. It’s faster, safer, cheaper, and, above all, way better.

We’re backed by investors including KKR, FTV Capital, Kindred, Notion, and 83North and serve over 10,000 software sellers in 245 territories globally.

The Role:

The way people find information is changing. Search now includes AI-generated answers, large language model (LLM) citations, and zero-click journeys. People often get an answer without visiting a website, so how a brand is understood and cited matters as much as where its pages rank.

We’re looking for an Organic & AI Search Manager to help Paddle show up well in those answers. You’ll shape how Paddle is understood, cited, and recommended by both people and machines. Ranking pages is part of that. Being cited and recommended is the rest. You’ll work across organic strategy, AI discoverability, and content, partnering closely with our Brand, product marketing (PMM), and Growth teams so the content we create is easy to find, trust, and surface in AI-generated answers.

Reporting to the Head of Web, you’ll connect the people who create content with the changing landscape of organic and AI-powered discovery. You’ll turn insight into strategy, and strategy into decisions.

You’ll also help move the work forward. You’ll help shape new content, and you’ll steer business-as-usual (BAU) updates, refreshes, and improvements that strengthen organic visibility, AI discoverability, and performance. Where it helps, you’ll draft first versions for review, using AI to speed that up. This is a broad role for someone who can move between spotting opportunities, making recommendations, and moving the work forward.

What you'll do:

  • Own Paddle’s organic and AI discoverability strategy, from brand awareness to category-level consideration, so we’re visible wherever our audience looks for answers

  • Audit our presence across traditional search, AI-generated responses, and LLM citation patterns, then build and maintain a prioritized roadmap based on the gaps

  • Turn organic and AI visibility data into clear content decisions for Brand, PMM, and Growth

  • Work with Creative, Social, and PR within Brand to structure, frame, and distribute content so search engines and LLMs can find and use it

  • Work with PMM to align messaging, terminology, and the topics we want Paddle to be known for, so we’re represented consistently wherever people look

  • Steer BAU content updates and refreshes, drafting first versions for review with the help of AI, and bring SEO and AEO input to new content

  • Define and track the metrics that show real discoverability (AI citation share, share of voice in LLM outputs, and organic visibility trends), and use them to create accountability across content functions

  • Link organic and AI visibility to commercial goals, and influence pipeline through the content and topics we prioritise

We'd love to hear from you if you:

  • Have a strong foundation in search engine optimisation (SEO), across technical, on-page, and off-page work, and are building expertise in AI and LLM discoverability, answer engine optimisation (AEO), or generative engine optimisation (GEO)

  • Understand how LLMs surface, cite, and recommend content, and have an informed view on how brands can influence that

  • Have experience working cross-functionally with content, brand, or product marketing teams, and have shaped and influenced how they work

  • Can steer content updates and produce a first draft for review, using AI to help

  • Are comfortable turning complex organic data and trends into clear direction for non-specialist stakeholders

  • Can connect organic performance to commercial outcomes such as pipeline, and explain the link to stakeholders

  • Can balance long-term strategic thinking with moving quickly and testing your hypotheses

  • Are curious about how information discovery is changing and have strong opinions on where it’s heading

Everyone is welcome at Paddle

At Paddle, we’re committed to removing invisible barriers, both for our customers and within our own teams. We recognise and celebrate that every Paddler is unique and we welcome every individual perspective. As an inclusive employer we don’t care if, or where, you studied, what you look like or where you’re from. We’re more interested in your craft, curiosity, passion for learning and what you’ll add to our culture. We encourage you to apply even if you don’t match every part of the job ad, especially if you’re part of an underrepresented group.

Please let us know if there’s anything we can do to better support you through the application process and in the workplace. We will do everything we can to support any accommodations needed. We’re committed to building a diverse team where everyone feels safe to be their authentic self. Let’s grow together.


Our Values

  • Paddle Together - “None of us, is as smart as all of us”

  • Paddle Simply - “Simple can be harder than complex: you have to get your thinking clean to make it simple”

  • Paddle for others - “We can realise our wildest dreams, so long as we help enough other people to realise theirs”

Why you’ll love working at Paddle

We are a diverse, growing group of Paddlers across the globe who pride ourselves on our transparent, collaborative and respectful culture.

We are a ‘digital-first’ company, which means you can work remotely, from one of our stylish hubs, or even a bit of both! We offer all team members unlimited holidays and 4 months paid family leave regardless of gender. We invest in learning and will help you with your personal development via constant exposure to new challenges, an annual learning fund, and regular internal and external training.

title: Staff Product Manager, Enterprise Deployment Solutions | UK | Remote
description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

This is a fully remote position and we're considering candidates in the UK.

About Product Management

As a Product Manager at Grafana Labs, you'll develop a vision and strategy for your product domain. You will own the experience for your product as well as its roadmap and competitive positioning, and you will collaborate with company leadership on setting your product's goals. You will be the primary advocate and expert in your area, with a strong ability to communicate needs, functionality, and details effectively both to external customers and internal stakeholders. The teams and people you will be interacting with will be 100% remote and globally distributed, so strong and proactive communication is essential.

Product Managers are the bridge that connects R&D to GTM. You are a facilitator who ensures the free flow of information across these teams and are expected to be technically proficient when representing our products to our customers.

The role

As the Staff Product Manager for Enterprise Deployment Solutions, you'll own the Grafana Labs offerings that run outside our standard multi-tenant SaaS. That includes Grafana Federal Cloud, for organizations that need FedRAMP-authorized observability: US federal agencies; state, local, and education (SLED) customers; and commercial companies that sell FedRAMP offerings of their own. It also includes Grafana Cloud Bring Your Own Cloud (BYOC), which delivers the full Grafana Cloud experience while the customer pays the infrastructure bill directly to their cloud provider, saving them significantly at scale.

Your mission is to make Grafana Labs the obvious choice for organizations that can't use standard SaaS because of compliance, data, or cost-at-scale constraints. Deployment choices change the product: features that are simple in standard SaaS can be hard, expensive, or impossible in a regulated or customer-owned environment. You’ll be responsible for adapting existing Grafana Cloud capabilities to these environments, deciding which features come in, which wait, and which stay out, and occasionally building something specific to BYOC or Federal Cloud. You'll also help shape which deployment models we offer next.

Along the way, you’ll use AI tools daily to speed up research, analyze product signals, and develop positioning, applying strong judgment to the results.

As the Staff Product Manager for Enterprise Deployment Solutions, you will:

  • Define the vision, strategy, and roadmap for the Grafana Bring Your Own Cloud and Grafana Federal Cloud products, using product data and market research to balance customer value against engineering cost and technical constraints
  • Own positioning, messaging, and differentiation for these products, including how they compare to regular Grafana Cloud, and partner with Product Marketing on launches, competitive analysis, enablement, and demand programs
  • Partner with Engineering and Technical Program Management on buildouts for these environments, balancing customer timelines with engineering capacity
  • Work directly with customers, prospects, and the field on strategic deals and brief partners, resellers, and analysts on our deployment options
  • Partner with Security, Compliance, and Legal to work through product changes affecting our authorization or existing customer commitments

We’re excited about you because you have

  • 5+ years of product management experience on a technical B2B product, or a technical background (software engineering, solutions architecture, SRE, or technical program management) plus a demonstrated move into product ownership
  • Hands-on experience with a non-standard SaaS deployment model, such as self-managed, air-gapped, sovereign, BYOC, single-tenant, or FedRAMP/government cloud, and a firsthand understanding of how it changes the product, its operations, and its economics
  • Experience with cloud infrastructure, platform software, or developer tools
  • Clear product and go-to-market judgment: you've shaped what a product should be and how it's positioned and sold, not only when it ships
  • Interest in working with US public sector customers and learning their needs and buying cycles. Deep compliance expertise isn't required.
  • Experience leading across multiple teams without direct authority, with excellent written and verbal communication in a remote, globally distributed organization

Bonus Points

  • Experience selling to or building for US federal, state, or local government customers, or other highly regulated industries
  • Familiarity with government or sovereign cloud frameworks, such as FedRAMP, StateRAMP/GovRAMP, BSI C5, or SecNumCloud, or with offerings such as AWS GovCloud, Azure Government, AWS European Sovereign Cloud, or GCP Sovereign Cloud
  • Experience with pricing and packaging across deployment models
  • Experience with observability, monitoring, or other data-intensive infrastructure products
  • Experience working with resellers, systems integrators, or cloud marketplace partners
  • Familiarity with open source software or commercial open source companies

In the UK, the base compensation range for this role is GBP 117,949- GBP 141,539. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.

Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:

  • 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
  • Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
  • Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
  • Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.
  • Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.
  • Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.
  • Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
  • Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.
  • Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
  • In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.
  • Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable.

title: Security Engineer, Incident Response
description:
Who we are

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.
.

Hiring and how we work

We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions!

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.
.

See yourself at Twilio

Join the team as Twilio’s next Security Engineer, Incident Response

About the job

The Security Incident Response Team (SIRT) is looking for a Security Engineer who is passionate about solving Twilio’s mission of security and reliability by working across the organization to lead the technical response to security events and incidents across Twilio’s global infrastructure, services and applications by effectively conducting triage, containment, remediation and driving post-incident betterments. You will work within a team that partners with R&D Engineering and R&D Business teams to develop scalable processes and technical solutions.

You will be a valued member of a team of deeply technical Security Engineers to focus on creating bespoke and standard Security response processes, enhancing our capabilities for threat mitigation and incident response, and then automating as much as you possibly can (and more)! You will help us to grow our global, scaled team and program.

Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll:

  • Lead and support the response to all security events and incidents across Twilio’s complex global infrastructure, services and applications.
  • Be responsible for documentation of incidents and projects you work on and craft best practices as runbooks and standard operating procedures to share knowledge across teams.
  • Work cross-collaboratively to understand and help solve challenges related to a broad spectrum of threat actors and activity.
  • Work to improve Twilio’s security and reliability posture by driving identified betterments from security events and incidents.
  • Rapidly acquire new technical skills and knowledge in a fast-paced, highly disruptive industry environment.
  • Own the security incident lifecycle, respond to incidents and participate in on-call rotation and participate in RCAs for security incidents.
  • Build, cultivate, and maintain positive relationships with internal customers to identify and facilitate solutions to increase the impact of the team’s work.
  • Provide mentorship, support, and care for the team in a way that enables long-term career development, happiness, and success at scale.

Qualifications

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

Required:

  • Proven experience: 3+ years of security incident response in a production-cloud environment
  • Subject-matter expert on security issues and technologies

title: Principal Enterprise Architect
description:
Headquarters: India (remote)

 Enterprise Architect - Cloud & AI

 Role Overview

 Jumio is not just processing transactions; we are pioneering the future of identity intelligence. To lead this transformation, you serve as a visionary AI Adoption Catalyst and Systems Architect , redefining our technical landscape. In this role, you aren’t a traditional gatekeeper—you are a Developer Advocate and mission-driven leader. You take end-to-end ownership of our architecture, positioning machine learning and GenAI at the heart of our DNA. Leveraging your deep expertise in AWS and cloud-native engineering, you provide the engine that empowers our developers to innovate at lightning speed, ensuring our multi-tenant SaaS platform remains the global benchmark for performance and scale.

 This is a mandate for a technical doer who thrives on the front lines. Building on our strong, scalable cloud foundation, you will actively champion the adoption of GenAI tools across the software development lifecycle while driving continuous architectural improvement, evolution, and operational cost optimization. Your proven experience in AWS is the toolkit you use to clear architectural roadblocks and optimize performance, enabling engineering teams to move with unprecedented velocity.

 As a strategic technical leader who stays close to the code, you inspire an AI-First culture. You bridge the gap between visionary enterprise design and pragmatic execution, driving cross-departmental impact while fostering self-service capabilities and cloud efficiency to ensure that as Jumio grows, our technology scales predictably and elegantly.

 Key Responsibilities

 End-to-End System Architecture & Optimization

• Own the technical vision for scalable, high-performance, cost-efficient systems.

• Define modern architecture patterns that enable growth, high TPS, and seamless scaling.

• Architect and optimize multi-tenant SaaS platforms, ensuring configurability and performance.

• Design self-service capabilities to reduce engineering overhead (e.g., self-service workflow designer, self-service rules engine, self-service reporting).

• Lead cloud cost efficiency initiatives, optimizing infrastructure, model execution, and compute resources.

• Collaborate closely with AWS Support and Solution Architects to optimize infrastructure and leverage cutting-edge cloud capabilities.

 Data & AI Infrastructure

• Architect high-scale, distributed data processing pipelines for batch and real-time workloads.

• Optimize data storage, retrieval, and processing layers to enhance system performance and reduce cost.

• Enable data self-service for analytics, ML, and real-time business use cases.

• Ensure data governance, security, and compliance across all systems.

 Technical Leadership & Hands-on Architecture

• Guide engineering teams on architectural best practices and pragmatic execution.

• Coach teams on scalable microservices, event-driven architectures, and cloud-native patterns.

• Practice "Architecting by Example" through technical prototyping and proof-of-concepts to validate architectural decisions.

 GenAI Acceleration & Architectural Advocacy

• You serve as the AI Adoption Catalyst and engineering champion, actively partnering with developers and business units to integrate LLMs and agentic workflows that securely hyper-automate the development lifecycle.

• You clear roadblocks and deploy agile architectural guardrails that empower teams to experiment rapidly with automated AI tools, building a self-service AI culture while maintaining rigorous cost-performance optimization.

• Your leadership evolves architectural governance into a collaborative platform for ensuring system-wide coherence, security, and world-class scalability.

 Architectural Governance & ARC Leadership

• Lead the Jumio Architecture Review Council (ARC) to drive cross-functional alignment and the evolution of our technical landscape.

• Establish and enforce architectural standards, ensuring consistency, security, and scalability across all product teams.

• Facilitate cross-team architectural reviews to identify technical debt, drive alignment, and ensure strategic coherence.

• Serve as the primary decision-maker for complex architectural trade-offs, balancing immediate delivery needs with long-term system health.

• Mentor engineering leadership on architectural best practices and standardized decision-making processes.

 Who You Are

• Strategic Visionary—you connect long-term business goals with robust technical roadmaps.

• Ultra-technical—you design, build, and optimize systems with a hands-on approach.

• System-First Thinker—you prioritize architecture, efficiency, and scale in every decision.

• Cloud-Native Expert—you utilize your deep AWS knowledge to optimize costs while improving system performance.

• Pragmatic Decision Maker—your impact-driven solutions ensure technical excellence without sacrificing speed.

• Builder’s Mentality—you thrive on automation, self-service, and reducing engineering toil through GenAI adoption.

• Growth-Oriented Mentor—you teach, coach, and elevate the engineering teams through architectural advocacy.

 Must-Have Skills & Experience

• 12+ years of hands-on experience in system architecture, data engineering, cloud engineering, or technical leadership roles.

• Experience with multi-tenant architectures and designing frameworks for configurable SaaS platforms.

• Deep, hands-on expertise in AWS (e.g., EKS, IAM, Lambda, networking) is required; professional experience with GCP is a strong plus.

• Strong experience with distributed systems, microservices, event-driven architectures, and caching strategies.

• Hands-on knowledge of AI/ML model execution—understanding model inference performance, cost trade-offs, and optimization strategies.

• Proficiency in high-scale transactional systems.

• Experience with infrastructure automation (Terraform, CI/CD, Kubernetes, Docker).

• Strong coding skills (Expert in Java, Strong in Python, Knowledgeable in JavaScript/TypeScript & Kotlin).

• Strong experience leading architectural review processes and fostering engineering standards.

• Proven expertise in integrating GenAI and ML methodologies into the software development lifecycle.

• Proven ability in strategic stakeholder management and complex financial/TCO (Total Cost of Ownership) analysis for enterprise technology.

 Nice-to-Have Skills

• Experience with high-volume, real-time data processing and distributed streaming architectures.

• Experience building petabyte-scale distributed data platforms.

• Familiarity with fraud prevention, identity verification, or authentication technologies.

 Why Join Us?

• Impact at scale —we process millions of transactions and solve real-world security and identity challenges .

• Modern technical foundation with room to innovate —leverage our established, scalable cloud architecture while actively driving continuous modernization, operational cost optimization, and solving complex technical challenges.

• Hands-on architecture leadership —you won’t be stuck in meetings; you’ll drive execution.

• Work alongside top engineers and AI/ML experts , pushing the limits of what’s possible.

• Competitive compensation and high ownership —your work will define how Jumio scales.

 Jumio Values:

 IDEAL: Integrity, Diversity, Empowerment, Accountability, Leading Innovation

 Equal Opportunities :

 Jumio is a collaboration of people with different ideas, strengths, interests and cultures. We welcome applications and colleagues from all backgrounds and of all statuses.

 About Jumio:

 Jumio is a B2B technology company dedicated to eradicating online identity fraud, money laundering and other financial crimes to help make the internet safer. We leverage AI, biometrics, machine learning, liveness detection and automation to create solutions that are trusted by leading brands worldwide and respected by industry thought leaders.

 Jumio is the leading provider of online identity verification, eKYC and AML solutions. With a global footprint, we’re expanding the team to meet strong client demand across a range of industries including Financial Services, Travel, Sharing Economy, Fintech, Gaming, and others.

Experience of team and workload management, and of working in an educational setting, would be an advantage.

title: Governance & Compliance Officer
description:
Function of the post:

To provide professional, effective and consistent governance and compliance support across the Trust and its designated Partnership Hub(s). The postholder will support the Trust Board, its committees and Local Governing Bodies (LGBs), ensuring that governance arrangements, statutory records, policies, meetings, panels and published information meet Trust, academy and legal requirements. The role will work closely with the Trust Governance & Compliance Manager, Company Secretary, Executive and Central Teams, Trustees, Governors, Headteachers, Academy Operations Officers and other relevant parties.

Principal Accountabilities:

  • Provide accurate and current advice and guidance to Trustees, Governors, Partnership Governance Professionals, Chairs, Headteachers and colleagues on governance legislation, statutory guidance, Trust procedures and good practice, escalating complex matters where appropriate.
  • Act as a key point of contact for designated LGBs and support the effectiveness of Trust and local governance through clear advice, timely communication, briefing papers and practical administrative support.
  • Coordinate governance self-evaluation, annual effectiveness reviews and skills audits, using outcomes to support development, succession planning and the strengthening of governance arrangements.
  • Manage governance membership processes for the Trust Board, its committees and LGBs, including appointments, terms of office, elections and re-elections, vacancies, outgoing members and local governor recruitment campaigns.
  • Maintain accurate and current governance records, including membership, attendance, training and declarations of interest, and ensure required information is updated on Get Information About Schools (GIAS), GovernorHub, Trust and academy websites and other relevant systems.
  • Support the induction and ongoing development of Trustees and Governors, including maintaining induction materials and supporting those taking on specialist or leadership responsibilities.
  • Provide professional clerking and governance support for allocated Trust Board, committee and LGB meetings, working with Chairs and senior leaders to prepare focused agendas aligned to the Trust governance calendar.
  • Prepare, collate and circulate meeting papers within required timescales; confirm quorum and procedural compliance; produce concise and accurate minutes that clearly record scrutiny, challenge, assurance, risk, decisions, actions and resolutions; and monitor completion of agreed actions.
  • Manage meeting and task calendars, governance correspondence, working-party records and evidence of formal approval for policies and other documents.
  • Coordinate the Trust policy framework, ensuring statutory and Trust policies are identified, allocated, reviewed, approved, published and retained in accordance with established requirements.
  • Lead or support quality assurance activity for statutory website compliance, governance records, policy management, complaints and information held within the Governance & Compliance function, reporting gaps and following through corrective action.
  • Liaise with Academy Operations Officers and academy administration teams to ensure academy web pages and governance information remain accurate and compliant with statutory and Trust requirements.
  • Oversee and coordinate statutory appeal committees and panels, including complaints, suspensions and permanent exclusions, and admission appeals. Arrange panel membership and documentation, provide procedural support, quality-assure and risk-assess packs, and liaise with all parties to ensure matters are handled promptly and in line with applicable procedures and statutory guidance
  • Provide administrative and procedural support in relation to complaints and other sensitive governance or compliance matters, maintaining confidentiality, accurate records and appropriate information handling.
  • Contribute to robust systems and processes for the Governance & Compliance function, identifying opportunities to improve consistency, efficiency, control and service quality across the Trust.
  • Attend Governance Team meetings, contribute to shared practice and service development, provide cover across the team when required, and support management of the shared governance inbox.
  • Complete mandatory training and maintain relevant continuing professional development in governance, compliance and associated statutory requirements.
  • Undertake other duties commensurate with the grade and nature of the post, as reasonably required.

Other duties:

You are required to undertake such other duties appropriate to the grade and content of the work as may reasonably be required of you including to understand and actively embrace the Trust’s distinctive sensibility, the qualities, values and characteristics expected of everyone working for our Trust.

The list of duties in this job profile should not be regarded as exclusive or exhaustive and require a flexible approach to work. Please note that, in consultation with you, the Trust reserves the right to update your job profile to reflect changes in, or to, your post. All staff have a role in supporting the Trust’s People Strategy.

You will work closely with Trust colleagues to align our premises management with DfE standards, share best practice, and ensure our site continues to support the very best environment for our pupils and staff.

What We Offer:

We offer a supportive well-resources environment with excellent opportunities for professional development within the school and in future, within the Trust.

 Competitive Intelligence & Win/Loss

 About the Role

 The market we compete in is being redrawn in real time. Point data providers are moving up the stack. Workflow and enrichment tools are repositioning as operating systems. Buyers are assembling their own stacks from components that used to be bought as a platform. Knowing what each competitor shipped last quarter is table stakes — the job is understanding what the pattern means and what we should do about it.

 This role owns competitive intelligence and win/loss for 6sense. It sits on the Product Marketing team and exists so that our positioning, our roadmap conversations and our field enablement are built on evidence rather than assumption. You will be the person the company turns to when there is a disagreement about why we win, why we lose, and who we are actually competing against.

 This is a senior individual contributor seat. The work is research, synthesis and judgment — and the willingness to tell the company something it would rather not hear, with the evidence to back it up.

 What You'll Own

•
 The win/loss program, end to end. Interviews, coding, synthesis and the readouts that go to product and executive leadership. Not administering a program — making it the thing people trust when they disagree.

•
 Competitive positioning and differentiation. The evidence behind our claims about where we are stronger, and the honesty about where we are not. You partner with the pillar PMMs so competitive insight shapes positioning rather than trailing it.

•
 Structural market analysis. How buyers are assembling their stacks, where substitution is happening, which categories are converging, and what that means for us eighteen months out.

•
 Field enablement for competitive situations. Battlecards, objection handling, trap-setting questions and talk tracks that hold up in a live deal rather than in a deck.

•
 Claims discipline for competitive material. Sourcing every competitive number we put in front of a customer, and saying no to the ones we cannot stand behind.

•
 Competitive monitoring and alerting, including ownership of the tooling and of what reaches the field versus what stays internal.

•
 Input to roadmap, pricing and packaging, and analyst relations. Competitive evidence should shape what we build and how we price, not only how we sell.

 What You'll Bring

•
 8+ years in competitive intelligence, product marketing or research-heavy go-to-market roles in B2B SaaS.

•
 Hands-on win/loss experience. Designing the program, running the interviews and coding the results — not reading someone else's summary.

•
 The ability to run primary research and be honest about what the data does and does not support. Small samples are useful; presenting them as more than they are is not.

•
 Strong synthesis and writing. An executive should be able to read your analysis and know what to do differently.

•
 Comfort presenting uncomfortable findings to product and executive audiences, and holding them under pushback.

•
 Fluency with the B2B SaaS buyer, ideally in martech, RevTech, sales intelligence or data platforms.

•
 Working knowledge of AI and agentic tooling — enough to evaluate what a competitor has actually shipped versus announced.

 Nice to Have

•
 Experience with competitive intelligence and research tooling (Klue, Gong, Dovetail or equivalent).

•
 Analyst relations exposure with Gartner or Forrester.

•
 Background in or adjacent to ABM, intent data, GTM intelligence or revenue platforms.

•
 Experience building a competitive intelligence function rather than inheriting one.

 What Success Looks Like

 In your first 6–12 months, win/loss is a program leaders act on rather than a report they receive; we know with evidence why we win and lose, by competitor and by segment; the field has competitive material that holds up in a live deal; and every competitive claim we make in market has a source behind it.

description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Location: Edinburgh (Hybrid) - 12 month FTC

In this position, you'll be based in the Edinburgh office for a minimum of three days a week, with the flexibility to work from home for some of your working week. Find out more about our flexible work culture at computershare.com/flex.

We give you a world of potential

Computershare has an exciting opportunity for several Graduate AI Engineer's to join our team in Edinburgh on a 12-month fixed term contract.

Working within our Technology team, you'll join our brand-new AI Hub, a growing team focused on delivering innovative technology solutions and exploring how emerging technologies can create value across our business.

Working closely with programme leaders, senior stakeholders and technical colleagues, you'll contribute to impactful initiatives, gain broad exposure across the organization and play a key role in the evolution of our technology landscape.

A role you will love

As a Graduate AI Engineer, you'll contribute to a range of AI Hub initiatives that are helping transform how Computershare operates, delivers technology and creates value. Working alongside experienced engineers, architects, data specialists and AI practitioners, you'll play a role in developing AI-powered tools, automation capabilities, prototypes and reusable platforms that support teams across the business.

This is an excellent opportunity to build hands-on experience in software engineering, generative AI, automation and cloud technologies, while working on real business challenges. You'll be supported by experienced colleagues and have the opportunity to learn modern engineering practices, develop your technical skills and thinking that will help drive the next phase of innovation across the organization.

Key responsibilities

  • Support the delivery of AI Hub initiatives across a variety of business and technology domains.
  • Build, test and enhance AI-powered tools, automations and reusable engineering capabilities.
  • Contribute to the development of standards, patterns, controls and best practices that support AI-enabled software delivery.
  • Assist in the creation of prototypes, proofs of concept and solutions that address real business challenges.
  • Track and evaluate emerging AI technologies, introducing and implementing capabilities within the AI Hub where they offer clear business value.
  • Help develop platforms, services and tooling that enable our teams across Computershare.
  • Collaborate with engineering, architecture, product and data teams to design, build and deliver innovative solutions.
  • Develop your technical and professional skills through hands-on delivery, mentoring and participation in AI Hub learning programmes.

What will you bring to the role?

As one of our Graduate AI Engineers, you'll bring a curious and creative mindset that wants to solve problems with a strong interest in technology, supported by knowledge gained through your studies, placements, internships or relevant work experience.

We're looking for someone who is eager to learn, willing to embrace new technologies and motivated to develop their skills in a rapidly evolving field. You'll enjoy solving problems, exploring new ideas and working collaboratively with others to deliver practical solutions. Strong communication skills are really important, as you'll work closely with colleagues across technology and business teams.

Other key skills and experience

  • A degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science or a related technical discipline. Equivalent practical experience will also be considered.
  • Foundational software engineering or programming skills, such as Java, .NET, SQL or similar technologies.
  • A genuine interest in AI, automation, software engineering and emerging technologies.
  • Awareness of Agile delivery methodologies, DevOps practices or cloud-based technologies.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to approach challenges logically and creatively.
  • The ability to work effectively within a collaborative team environment.
  • A proactive approach to learning, with a willingness to continuously develop new skills and knowledge.

If you're excited by the opportunity to work with AI, contribute to technology transformation and help shape innovative solutions that create real business value, we'd love to hear from you.

Flexible work to help you find the best balance between work and lifestyle

Health and wellbeing rewards that can be tailored to support you and your family

Invest in our business by setting aside salary to purchase shares in our company, and you'll receive a company contribution as well.

Extra rewards ranging from recognition awards and team get togethers to helping you invest in your future

And more. Ours is a welcoming and close-knit community, with experienced colleagues ready to help you grow. Our careers hub will help you find out more about our rewards and life at Computershare, visit computershare.com/careershub

title: Senior Solutions Engineer | UK | Remote
description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

The Opportunity

The Solutions Engineering team are the customer facing product experts. The team enables Grafana Labs worldwide growth by educating potential and existing customers to ensure that they are happy and successful. We share our technical and product expertise with customers through demos, hands on enablement, presentations, technical evaluations and ongoing interaction. We partner closely with our Sales team to help qualify and close opportunities. The Solutions Engineering team is one of the primary routes of communication from our customers to the Product Management and Engineering teams.

A Solutions Engineer is able to really listen to a prospect or customer, understand their requirements, ask the right questions to extract as much information as required and translate all that into a solution with Grafana Labs technology. They are the bridge between the highly technical engineering folks here at Grafana Labs, our customers and our Sales team.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Partnering with our Sales team to articulate the overall Grafana value proposition, vision and strategy to customers
  • Owning the technical engagement with customers and help close complex opportunities through advanced competitive knowledge, technical skill and credibility
  • Delivering product and technical presentations to potential and existing customers
  • Effectively communicate with customers and internal teams to provide feedback on our products and the competitive landscape
  • Driving product conversations based on need and problems with customers
  • Working with the team to enhance documentation, write blog posts, record videos, contribute knowledge base articles and create other public or private enablement material

What Makes you a Great Fit:

  • 5+ years of technical pre-sales experience
  • Be open to various and complex assignments, this will require strong judgment, collaboration, and leadership
  • You will need first class written and oral communication skills to collaborate with our remote-first internal teams and with our worldwide customers. You will need to be able to skillfully articulate our value proposition and the technical advantages of our products
  • You love solving technical challenges and thrive on bringing creative solutions to our customers
  • You should have a technical mindset and a desire to grow technically.
  • Must be located in United Kingdom

Bonus Points For:

  • Experience with Open Source technologies, or in the Metrics/Monitoring space is an advantage
  • Experience with sales methodologies like MEDD(P)ICC is a plus

Compensation & Rewards

In the UK, the OTE (On-Target Earnings) compensation range for this role is EUR 110,000 - EUR 134,000. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.

Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:

  • 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
  • Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
  • Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
  • Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.
  • Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.
  • Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.
  • Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
  • Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.
  • Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
  • In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.
  • Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable.

title: Senior Director, Professional Services
description:
About Keyfactor

Our mission is to securely connect the world: humans, machines, and AI. Keyfactor is the leader in trust infrastructure for AI and machines, helping the world's largest enterprises and government agencies take control of the cryptographic identities that safeguard every digital interaction. Behind the platform is a global team of people who care deeply about the work and each other. We move fast, think big, and show up for one another every day. If you're looking for work that matters and a team that brings out your best, we hope you'll trust your future with Keyfactor!

Title: Senior Director, Professional Services

Location: United Kingdom (Remote)

Experience: Managerial

Job Function: Professional Services

Employment Type: Full-Time

Industry: Cost of Goods Sold

Travel Requirements: 25%

About the position

The Senior Director of Global Professional Services, provides visionary leadership in Global Professional Services, driving strategic initiatives and overseeing transformational projects. Builds key executive relationships, ensures financial health, establishes global standards, drives innovation, and fosters a culture of high performance and continuous improvement throughout the organization.

Job Responsibilities

  • Provide visionary leadership for the entire Global Professional Services organization, driving strategic initiatives and organizational growth.
  • Develop and execute long-term strategies to enhance service delivery, customer satisfaction, and business performance.
  • Lead a team of Directors, ensuring alignment with organizational goals and strategic objectives.
  • Drive large-scale transformation initiatives to improve operational efficiency and service quality.
  • Build and maintain relationships with key executive stakeholders, both internal and external.
  • Oversee the financial health of the Professional Services organization, ensuring sustainable growth and profitability.
  • Represent the organization in top-tier customer engagements, industry conferences, and executive briefings.
  • Establish and enforce global standards, processes, and best practices for project delivery.
  • Drive innovation and the adoption of cutting-edge technologies to stay ahead of industry trends.
  • Ensure global compliance with regulatory requirements, industry standards, and contractual obligations.
  • Champion a culture of high performance, accountability, and continuous improvement across the entire organization.

Minimum Qualifications, Education, and Skills

  • Bachelor's degree in a relevant field such as Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Administration, or equivalent experience.
  • Deep knowledge in a technical, MSP, or software consulting capacity with commiserate leadership experience.
  • Capability to lead organizational change, influence company-wide strategy, and drive business growth.
  • Complex reporting capabilities with Excel, or other BI software with the ability to use the data to effectively communicate and persuade an audience.
  • Visionary leadership, advanced strategic planning, exceptional stakeholder engagement.
  • Strong and effective communication skills in a consultative manner with customers and internal/external stakeholders.
  • Advanced, methodical, and expedient business troubleshooting and problem-solving abilities without needing escalation to other leaders.
  • Consistently speaks with confidence to technical, non-technical, and executive audiences internally and externally, effectively de-escalating any situation.
  • Demonstrates advanced interpersonal communication and writing abilities with autonomy.

#LI-NA1

Compensation

Salary will be commensurate with experience. 

Culture, Career Opportunities and Benefits

We build teams that continually strive to get better than the day before. You will be challenged daily and given opportunities to grow personally and professionally. We balance autonomy and structure to create an entrepreneurial environment to spur creativity and new ideas. 

Here are just some of the initiatives that make our culture special:  

  • Second Fridays (a company-wide day off on the second Friday of every month minus November and December due to the Holiday schedule). Please note that this benefit is subject to change.
  • Comprehensive benefit coverage globally.
  • Paid Parental Leave is available to new parents. Structure varies based on regional/government requirements. In regions where government-paid leave doesn’t exist, like in the U.S., the company offers generous paid parental leave, along with comprehensive adoption and fertility support.
  • Competitive time off globally.
  • Dedicated employee-focused ambassadors via Key Contributors & Culture Committees.
  • DIVERSE Commitment, a call to action for a more inclusive and diverse future in business, society, and technology.
  • The Keyfactor Alliance Program to support DEIB efforts.
  • Wellbeing resources, wellness allowance, mindfulness app free membership, Wellness Wednesdays.
  • Global Volunteer Day, company non-profit matching, and 3 volunteer days off.
  • Monthly Talent development and Cross Functional meetings to support professional development.
  • Regular All Hands meetings – followed by group gatherings.

Our Core Values

Our core values are extremely important to how we run our business and what we look for in every team member:  

Trust is paramount.  

We deliver security software and solutions where trust and openness are of the highest importance for our customers. We are honest and a trusted partner in every aspect of business.  

Customers are core.  

We strategize, operate, and execute through a customer-centric view. We prioritize the security interests of our customers, and we act as if their data were our own.  

Innovation never stops, it only accelerates.  

The speed of change is accelerating. We are committed, through investment and focus, to stay ahead of the innovation curve.  

We deliver with agility.   

We thrive in high-paced and continually changing environments. We navigate through newly added variables, adjust accordingly, while driving towards our strategic goals.  

United by respect.   

Respect for all is what unites us. We promote diversity, inclusivity, equity, and acting with empathy and openness, both in our business and in our communities.  

Teams make “it” happen.  

Vision and goals are not individually achievable – they require teamwork. We pride ourselves in operating as a cohesive team, creating promoters and partners, and winning as one.  

Keyfactor is a proud equal opportunity employer including but not limited to veterans and individuals with disabilities. 

REASONABLE ACCOMMODATION: Applicants with disabilities may contact a member of Keyfactor’s People team via people@keyfactor.com and/or telephone at 1.216.785.2990 to request and arrange for accommodations at any time.
