About the Role

The Strategic Project Lead – Speech & Audio will sit in Appen's Operations organization and support the development of frontier AI through high-quality data programs for leading AI companies. We’re looking for someone with experience in speech, audio, or language data to own complex projects from planning through delivery.

You’ll combine project management, domain expertise, and quality ownership to help clients build and improve speech recognition systems, voice agents, and other AI applications. You’ll work closely with clients and internal teams to solve problems, refine workflows, and keep pace with a rapidly evolving AI landscape.

Your Impact

  • Own end-to-end delivery across project scope, timelines, budgets, staffing, and risks.
  • Manage client communication, status updates, workshops, and escalations.
  • Translate client requirements into annotation guidelines, workflows, tooling, and quality standards.
  • Define and monitor quality metrics, including transcription accuracy, word error rate (WER), diarization, and linguistic consistency.
  • Troubleshoot quality issues and resolve ambiguous requirements with clients.
  • Provide domain expertise across speech and audio workflows, advising on feasibility, evaluation methods, and tooling.
  • Build reusable guidelines, SOPs, and QA frameworks while mentoring Operations Specialists.
  • Support new project scoping, pilots, and capability development as speech and voice AI evolves.

What You Bring

  • 1–2+ years of experience in AI data operations, project coordination, or delivery, ideally in a GenAI or frontier AI environment.
  • Hands-on familiarity with at least one speech, audio, language, or conversational AI workflow.
  • Experience coordinating projects or workstreams, managing stakeholders, and communicating with clients.
  • Understanding of data quality, annotation workflows, and quality assurance methods.
  • Ability to turn client requirements into clear guidelines, workflows, and quality standards.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-moving environment.
  • Interest in current AI developments and how speech, audio, and voice-agent technologies are evolving.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with ASR transcription, speaker diarization, acoustic annotation, or TTS evaluation.
  • Familiarity with voice-agent scripts, IVR, dialogue design, turn-taking, or conversational evaluation.
  • Experience with localization, cross-locale consistency, CJK languages, or low-resource languages.
  • Bilingual or multilingual capabilities, particularly German or a Nordic language.

Why You'll Love Working Here

At Appen, we foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and excellence. We value curiosity, accountability, and a commitment to delivering the highest quality AI solutions for frontier models.

You'll work on complex challenges that shape the future of AI across industries and geographies, alongside talented people in a culture that values humility over ego. You'll have the flexibility to deliver in a way that works for you and your team, supported by tools, resources, and development opportunities to continue to build your capability over time.

About Appen

Appen has been a leader in AI training data for over 30 years. We specialise in human generated data to train, fine tune, and evaluate models across generative AI, large language models, computer vision, and speech recognition. Our AI assisted data annotation platform and global crowd of more than 1 million contributors in over 200 countries support model pre training, supervised fine tuning, evaluation and benchmarking, safety and red teaming, and multilingual global expansion.

description:
About the Role

The Strategic Project Lead – Multimodal AI supports frontier AI development through complex, high-quality data programs for leading AI companies. We’re looking for someone with experience in multimodal AI data, such as image, video, 3D, sensor, or robotics-related workflows.

You’ll lead projects that turn complex real-world data into reliable training and evaluation resources. Combining project management with hands-on domain knowledge, you’ll partner with clients and internal teams to design workflows, maintain quality, and solve challenging data delivery problems in a rapidly evolving AI market.

Your Impact

  • Own end-to-end project delivery across scope, timelines, budgets, staffing, and risks.
  • Lead client communication, status reporting, planning sessions, and escalations.
  • Translate technical and client requirements into data collection workflows, annotation guidelines, tooling, and quality standards.
  • Define quality metrics and acceptance criteria for multimodal data and annotation outputs.
  • Monitor delivery quality, troubleshoot data issues, and resolve ambiguous requirements with clients.
  • Advise on project feasibility, collection methods, annotation approaches, and tooling based on your domain expertise.
  • Build reusable SOPs, guidelines, and QA frameworks to support consistent delivery.
  • Mentor Operations Specialists and contribute to project scoping, pilots, and emerging multimodal AI capabilities.

What You Bring

  • 1–2+ years of experience in AI data operations, project coordination, or delivery, ideally in a GenAI or frontier AI environment.
  • Familiarity with at least one multimodal data workflow involving images, video, 3D data, sensors, or robotics.
  • Experience coordinating projects or workstreams, managing stakeholders, and communicating with clients.
  • Understanding of data quality, annotation workflows, and quality assurance methods.
  • Ability to translate project requirements into clear data collection workflows, annotation guidelines, and quality standards.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-moving environment.
  • Interest in current AI developments, including multimodal models, spatial AI, or embodied AI.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with image or video annotation, 3D data, point clouds, or sensor data.
  • Familiarity with robotics data collection or real-world perception workflows.
  • Exposure to 2D or 3D labeling, segmentation, tracking, or structured annotation tasks.
  • Experience with autonomous systems, spatial AI, or embodied AI.
  • Bilingual capabilities, particularly German or a Nordic language.

Why You'll Love Working Here

At Appen, we foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and excellence. We value curiosity, accountability, and a commitment to delivering the highest quality AI solutions for frontier models.

You'll work on complex challenges that shape the future of AI across industries and geographies, alongside talented people in a culture that values humility over ego. You'll have the flexibility to deliver in a way that works for you and your team, supported by tools, resources, and development opportunities to continue to build your capability over time.

About Appen

Appen has been a leader in AI training data for over 30 years. We specialise in human generated data to train, fine tune, and evaluate models across generative AI, large language models, computer vision, and speech recognition. Our AI assisted data annotation platform and global crowd of more than 1 million contributors in over 200 countries support model pre training, supervised fine tuning, evaluation and benchmarking, safety and red teaming, and multilingual global expansion.

title: Senior Database Reliability Engineer I - Germany/Austria/UK
description:
Headquarters: Remote

 Storyblok is a headless CMS that enables marketers and developers to create with joy and publish with confidence. It empowers you to deliver structured and consistent content everywhere: websites, apps, AI search, and beyond.

 Legendary brands like Virgin Media O2, Oatly, and TomTom use Storyblok to make a bigger, faster market impact.

 WHAT IS IN IT FOR YOU

 You will be joining a growing company where you can contribute to many “firsts”. Plus these benefits:

• Monthly remote work stipend (home internet costs, electricity). Home office equipment package right at the start (laptop, keyboard, monitor…)

• Home office equipment upgrade (furniture, ear plugs …) or membership to a local co-working space after your onboarding

• Sick leave benefit, parental leave and 25 days of annual leave plus your local national holidays

• Personal development fund for courses, books, conferences, and material

• The annual international team-building trip, quarterly and monthly online get-togethers

• As a fully remote company, with work-life balance at its core, you’ll enjoy flexible schedules

• An international team that loves to have fun at work and works hard together to accomplish shared goals

 JOB SUMMARY

 You will own the reliability, performance, and cost efficiency of the PostgreSQL data platform behind our flagship CMS — primarily Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL — along with the infrastructure and automation around it.

 This is a reliability engineering role, not a classic administration one. Aurora takes care of patching, backups, failover, and storage growth; you own what it does not — query and index strategy, plan regressions across major version upgrades, vacuum and bloat, connection management, zero-downtime schema change, logical replication, and capacity and cost modeling. Alongside this, you work as a full member of the Infrastructure team on Terraform, CI/CD, observability, and security tooling, and you share the on-call rotation.

 You will work in a shared-ownership model: backend teams own their queries and schemas, and you own the platform, guardrails, tooling, and knowledge-sharing that make their decisions safe. You will collaborate closely with backend engineers, DevOps engineers, Security, product owners, and the Data team.

 We measure success by the reliability and predictable performance of the data platform, the quality of your incident response, and how well other engineering teams are equipped to make sound database decisions without you in the room.

 ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS

 Database platform (approx. 60%)

• Own the reliability, performance, and scalability of our PostgreSQL platform (primarily Amazon Aurora): query and index strategy, execution plans, configuration tuning, and capacity planning, with particular attention to hot multi-tenant read paths.

• Lead zero-downtime version upgrades and schema migrations at scale, including diagnosing and preventing plan regressions across Aurora major versions.

• Own the operational health of the platform: vacuum strategy and bloat, long-running transactions and wraparound risk, connection management and pooling (including RDS Proxy), lock contention, and logical replication and slot hygiene.

• Review schema changes and DDL from backend teams for lock behavior, migration safety, and performance impact, and build the guardrails and tooling that make safe changes to the default path.

• Own backup, restore, and disaster recovery end-to-end, including rehearsed restore drills and the access, encryption, and auditing controls our compliance obligations require.

• Model database capacity and cost (I/O-Optimized vs. Standard, Serverless v2 sizing, read replica strategy) and drive cost-efficiency without compromising reliability.

 Infrastructure and automation (approx. 40%)

• Deliver infrastructure and automation as a full member of the Infrastructure team, using Terraform and cloud-native tooling on AWS, and contribute to CI/CD pipelines including the safe automated handling of database changes.

• Build and maintain monitoring, alerting, and observability for database and platform systems (e.g. pg_stat_statements, Prometheus exporters, Grafana, Datadog, OpenTelemetry) so problems surface before customers feel them.

• Use cloud security and vulnerability management tooling (such as Aikido) to triage findings and keep the team's services compliant.

 Team, incidents, and collaboration

• Take part in the on-call rotation, incident response, and postmortems, driving root cause analysis and remediation that prevents recurrence.

• Raise the database competence of the wider engineering organization through design reviews, documentation and runbooks, and mentoring — so this expertise is not concentrated in one person.

• Demonstrate AI literacy, leveraging AI tools to enhance productivity, decision-making, and quality of work while applying sound judgment and critical thinking.

 EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE; QUALIFICATIONS

 Required — PostgreSQL depth

• 7+ years in database engineering, database reliability, infrastructure, or SRE roles, including significant hands-on ownership of production PostgreSQL.

• Deep PostgreSQL expertise: internals and MVCC, reading and acting on EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS), indexing strategy, vacuum behavior, locking, connection pooling, and configuration tuning.

• Strong experience with Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL and AWS-managed database services.

• Proven track record of zero-downtime upgrades and complex schema migrations on large, busy tables.

• Hands-on experience with physical and logical replication, partitioning, read scaling, and designing and validating backup and disaster-recovery strategies.

 Required — Infrastructure and ways of working

• Solid experience with Infrastructure-as-Code, primarily Terraform, on AWS.

• Strong Linux fundamentals plus fluency in at least one scripting language (Bash, Python, Ruby, or Go) for automation and tooling.

• Experience with monitoring and observability tooling, and a solid grasp of security practices (IAM, secrets management, network segmentation).

• Experience with change, incident, and problem management in production, and with Git and modern CI/CD workflows applied to database changes.

• Strong written and verbal communication in a remote-first organization, including the ability to explain database trade-offs to backend engineers and non-specialists.

• Willingness and ability to participate in an on-call rotation.

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

 Nice to have

• Familiarity with backend frameworks that interact with PostgreSQL (Ruby on Rails preferred; Python, Rust, or Elixir valued).

• Experience with caching layers (Redis, Memcached) and their interaction with database load.

• Exposure to analytics pipelines and warehousing (Redshift, Snowflake, ClickHouse) or CDC-based data flows.

• Experience with container platforms (ECS, EKS, Fargate), NoSQL or vector databases, or AWS certification (Database – Specialty, DevOps Engineer – Professional).

 MENTAL, PHYSICAL AND ENVIRONMENTAL REQUIREMENTS

 Remote (home) work opportunity or funded by Storyblok co-working space

 GENERAL TERMS

 Storyblok has a commitment to diversity and inclusion. We strive to create a hiring environment in which all people feel they are equally respected and valued, irrespective of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, ethnicity, age, religion, citizenship or any other characteristic. You can find more information about our privacy policy here .

 All communications regarding job opportunities at Storyblok will come from an official Storyblok employee with an email address ending in @storyblok.com. We will never redirect you to another portal or another site that is unrelated to our domain ( storyblok.com ).

 Here is a sneak peek of Storyblok’s Visual Editor

 If you need an accommodation for any part of the application process, please email talent.acquisition@storyblok.com

title: Manager, Professional Services Federal
description:
Headquarters: Remote, USA

 Joining Collibra’s Professional Services Team

 At Collibra Public Sector (CPS), the Manager, Federal Professional Services is responsible for leading all services roles and functions to ensure the long-term success, adoption, and satisfaction of government clients. The role drives a cohesive customer journey, aligns services delivery with other CPS delivery to mission outcomes, and ensures operational excellence across the entire customer lifecycle. This role safeguards account health, revenue, and customer satisfaction by proactively identifying and mitigating technical risk, coordinating services engagements, and building operational frameworks for GTM clarity and alignment amongst the services teams.

 Federal Engagement Managers at Collibra Public Sector are responsible for

 Services Management

• Manage services operations and resources, including Engagement Manager and Solution Architects, ensuring timely and successful project execution and value delivery.

• Manages professional service team in respect to project milestones, delivery and goals.

• Responsible for team utilization and revenue optimization.

• Drive operational excellence in services delivery.

• Monitor performance to ensure teams are performing within expectations and achieving high levels of project success.

• Collaborate on GTM strategy for CPS Services, helping shape how services is positioned, sold, and delivered throughout the customer journey.

• Guide sales enablement and customer-facing messaging, ensuring services' value proposition is clear, consistent, and aligned with customer needs.

• Evaluate pricing and packaging strategies for new and existing offerings.

• Identify expansion opportunities and influence sales motions with timely insights.

• Contribute to strategic deal support, partnering with Sales and Finance on high-impact renewals, expansions, and new business that include services offerings.

• Engages with new / prospective customers to identify business challenges and opportunities, recommend solutions / solution enhancements and propose a high-level delivery roadmap based on expected business value.

 Customer Project Oversight

• Guide project team members through scoping and level of effort estimates.

• Ensure effective controls are in place and regularly updated in order to monitor the full implementation project lifecycle including: project plans, status reports, time recording, resource planning, and first value forecasting.

• Advises implementation project teams and customers on milestone achievement, issue resolution and change management.

• Ensures effective controls are in place to monitor the full implementation project lifecycle.

• Develops and tracks overall project success, customer satisfaction, and quality of delivery.

• Maintains and nurtures consultative relationships with key customer leadership and decision-makers.

• Establishes and ensures effective execution of solution delivery accelerating the customer's time to value.

• Perform post-project reviews to ensure achievement of business objectives.

 Customer Journey Mapping and Operational improvement

• Assist with the design, execution, and continuous improvement of the end-to-end customer journey.

• Implement frameworks to continuously assess services customer value realization, using structured feedback and data to refine operational and delivery models.

• Drive maturity in delivery practices, tooling, and customer engagement models.

• Standardize and operationalize proactive engagement workflows in relation to the technical teams (e.g., onboarding, QBRs, Value delivery, and Renewal motions).

• Identify trends and opportunities for improvement within the services organization, and implement solutions to enhance customer success and team efficiency.

• Captures lessons learned and ensures their application to future project planning and process improvement.

 Team Leadership & Development

• Lead, coach, and mentor a team of Engagement Managers and Solution Architects, empowering them to deliver an exceptional customer experience.

• Foster a culture of accountability, high performance, and customer obsession.

• Recruit, mentor, and retain top talent with expertise in government operations.

• Cultivate an environment that fosters collaboration, knowledge sharing, and continuous learning.

• Ensures timely and effective communication of departmental goals and objectives internally within the department and more broadly with cross-functional stakeholders.

• Develop and implement strategies to achieve team and individual performance goals, exceeding customer, organization and company expectations.

• Ensures that training, coaching and mentoring programs are developed, implemented and effective for the team.

 Customer Risk Prevention, Assessment & Management

• Build and manage frameworks for early identification of at-risk projects or customers in relation to services engagements.

• Act as a management escalation point for the Services team encountering project obstacles, and liaise with internal teams for resolution.

• Support employees in raising issues associated with customer and project risk.

• Partner with Sales and the other technical GTM teams to identify and mitigate renewal or churn risk.

• Support proactive risk reviews for strategic/enterprise accounts.

• Manages pivotal customer issues and concerns through the team, directly handling escalated issues.

• Drive customer project At-Risk post-mortems and ensure preventive actions are implemented.

 You have:

• A U.S. citizen who resides on U.S. soil as the role supports the U.S. government.

• 5+ years of experience in consulting supporting U.S. federal agencies.

• A minimum of 2 years of experience managing services teams in the support of U.S. federal agencies.

• Excellent communication, organization, and stakeholder management skills.

• Strong leadership skills collaborating with Sr Executives on a frequent basis.

• Knowledge in the areas of Data Governance, Data Management or Data Quality.

• Have previous military experience.

• Hold an active security clearance (Secret/TS/TS-SCI).

• Knowledgeable of at least two or three of the following: data management processes, including data governance, data stewardship, master data management, data cataloging, and business rules management.

• An understanding of the leading PaaS providers, Data Lakes, Databases, and Integration platforms commonly adopted by federal agencies.

• Experience with AWS/Azure, Kubernetes, infrastructure and platform.

• An understanding of APIs via Java, Python, or similar scripting language for custom software implementations in Enterprise Linux or Unix environments.

• An understanding of data warehousing, ETL, data integration.

 You are

• An effective communicator across business and technical stakeholders and able to tailor to different audiences.

• Extremely organized with a high attention to detail.

• Always customer-focused and personally hold yourself accountable for the customer’s success.

• Self-starting and interested in learning new software.

• Able to lead Senior Level customer discussions representing CPS and services engagements.

 Measures of Success

• Within the first 30 days of employment, be able to

• Clearly understand the roles and responsibilities of the reporting employees and the account assignments.

• Present the services offering, understanding the different deliverables and the value provided.

• Present the Customer Journey framework, understanding the different phases and roles and responsibilities within each phase.

• Clearily understand the roles and responsibilities of all delivery personnel including an Engagement Manager, Solution Architect, Account Program Manager, Premium Support Engineer, Sales Engineer and Account Executive.

• Within the first 60 days of employment

• Navigate Salesforce including opportunities, utilization, projects, and quotes.

• Identify customers and services engagements at Risk and build a plan to remediate.

• Identify process gaps and inefficiencies within the services organization.

• Present the services offering to a customer.

• Within the first 90 days of employment be able to

• Advise Sales on proposed services engagements.

• Build Salesforce reports for visibility into Services engagements including utilization.

• Build playbooks to address process gaps and inefficiencies within the services organization.

• Execute remediation plan for customers at risk collaborating with the sales, support, and technical teams.

• Understand and convey to customers how Collibra's suite product capabilities and the projects being delivered provide value to customers.

 Compensation for this role

 The standard base salary range for this position is $128,000 - 160,000 per year. This position is eligible for additional commission-based compensation. Salary offers are based on a combination of factors, including, but not limited to, experience, skills, and location.

 In addition to base salary, we offer a competitive total rewards package, including bonus potential, equity for eligible roles, a Flex Fund monthly stipend, pension/401k plans, and more.

 Benefits at Collibra

 Collibra recognizes and values that everyone has different needs, interests, and life goals. We built our benefits program with flexibility in mind to support you and your loved ones through a diverse range of circumstances and life events. These flexible offerings sit on a foundation of competitive compensation, health coverage, and time off. Learn more about Collibra’s benefits .

 We create inclusion and belonging through how we onboard, meet, connect, engage, and communicate. Learn more about diversity, equity, and inclusion at Collibra.

 At Collibra, we’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We realize the key to creating a company with a world-class culture and employee experience comes from who we hire and creating a workplace that celebrates everyone.

 With this, we proudly consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, pregnancy, sex, gender identity, gender expression, genetic information, physical or mental disability, HIV status, registered domestic partner status, caregiver status, marital status, veteran or military status, citizenship status or any other legally protected category. If you have a need that requires accommodation, let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

 To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/collibra-manager-professional-services-federal

Experience in education or the public sector is desirable but not essential.

What we’re looking for:

We are seeking an individual who can demonstrate:

title: Trust HR Officer
description:
Greater Manchester Academies Trust (GMAT) is seeking a friendly, organised, and dedicated HR Officer to support the smooth running of our HR operations. This is a fantastic opportunity to join a welcoming team at an exciting point in our journey, as we continue to build an efficient and supportive central function for our growing Trust.

We are looking for someone who is passionate about helping others, enjoys working with people, and takes pride in delivering excellent administrative and HR support. Your role will play an important part in making sure our schools are great places to work and learn.

About Us

Greater Manchester Academies Trust includes:

  • Manchester Communication Academy
  • Manchester Communication Primary Academy
  • Manchester Communication Research School

We are committed to providing high-quality education for children and young people in Manchester. Our work is guided by five core values: trustworthy, helpful, inspiring, straightforward, and heart.

About the Role

We are seeking a dedicated HR Officer to join our team. In this pivotal role, you will provide comprehensive, high-quality administrative and operational support across the full employee lifecycle - from recruitment and onboarding to payroll administration, attendance monitoring, and compliance.

Working closely with senior leadership, you will serve as a key point of contact for day-to-day HR queries, ensuring our policies and processes run smoothly, efficiently, and in full alignment with employment law and safer recruitment standards.

Key Responsibilities

Safer Recruitment & Onboarding: Coordinate end-to-end recruitment campaigns, conduct pre-employment vetting (DBS, references, qualifications, right to work, and online due diligence searches), and issue offer documentation.

Statutory Compliance: Maintain an accurate and up-to-date Single Central Record (SCR) in strict adherence to Keeping Children Safe in Education (KCSIE).

Absence & Payroll Support: Record staff absences, support return-to-work procedures, coordinate occupational health referrals, and prepare monthly payroll variations.

Employee Relations & Advice: Provide initial guidance to staff and line managers on standard HR queries, policies, and conditions of service.

HR Information Systems: Maintain accurate staff files and workforce records on our HR database in compliance with GDPR.

About You

The ideal candidate will hold a CIPD Level 3 qualification (or equivalent experience) and demonstrate solid administrative experience within a generalist HR environment. You will possess excellent communication skills, outstanding attention to detail, and the confidence to handle sensitive and confidential matters with discretion.

Prior experience working within an education setting or Multi-Academy Trust, along with familiarity with safer recruitment regulations, is highly desirable.

Why Join GMAT?

At GMAT, you’ll be part of a team that genuinely cares about people. You’ll work in a supportive environment where you can develop your skills and contribute to the success of our schools and communities.

If you’re looking to grow your career in HR and make a difference behind the scenes, we’d love to hear from you.

Interested in finding out more?

We believe recruitment is a two-way process — we want the right person for the role, and we want this to be the right place for you. If you're curious or have questions, we’d be delighted to speak with you before you apply.

Please contact hr@gmatrust.co.uk to arrange a conversation or visit.

The closing date for applications is 11 November 2026.

Please note: We reserve the right to close this advert early if we receive a high volume of strong applications. Early applications are encouraged.

You will have strong communication and administrative skills, a confident approach to using IT systems and the initiative to resolve routine issues, identify potential problems and escalate matters appropriately. Above all, you will be committed to providing a responsive, professional and helpful service to colleagues across the Trust.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys working as part of a collaborative team and takes pride in delivering efficient, accurate and high-quality administrative support. Most importantly, you will contribute to the effective management of the Trust's resources, estates and operations, helping to ensure our schools are well supported and able to deliver the best possible outcomes for our pupils.

Please note that this is a year-round post (not a term-time position).

Information about the School

Discovery Educational Trust, formed in 2014, is a successful and established multi-academy trust based in South Essex, comprising just under 4000 pupils and 500 staff, across 5 schools.

Our schools are:

  • Chase High School (Westcliff-on-Sea)
  • St. Martin's School (Brentwood)
  • Hogarth Primary School (Brentwood)
  • Kelvedon Hatch Community Primary School (Brentwood)
  • Larchwood Primary School (Brentwood)

Our vision is that strong and effective leadership places our children and young people at the heart of everything we do. We value relationships, which are open and honest, underpinned by kindness, trustworthiness and compassion.

We offer ongoing training and professional development for all staff in a supportive and collaborative environment.

  • Pension scheme - also automatically includes Life Assurance
  • Generous Referral Bonus for employees who refer quality candidates to join Discovery Educational Trust
  • Two-week October half term (term time staff)

  • Employee Assistance Programme - free confidential wellbeing support for employees and dependants
  • Mental Health First Aiders - we have qualified MHFA England trainers within the Trust and continue to add to our pool of trained MHFAs
  • Bike2Work scheme
  • Ongoing training and professional development in a supportive and collaborative environment
  • Gifted Service Leave for long service
  • Health Cash plan to support with every day healthcare costs - e.g. dental, optical, physiotherapy. Includes Virtual GP service

As an equal opportunities employer, Discovery Educational Trust is committed to the equal treatment of all current and prospective employees and does not condone discrimination on the basis of age; disability; gender re-assignment; marriage and civil partnership; pregnancy and maternity; race (which includes ethnic origin, nationality and ethnic or national origins); religion or belief; sex; and sexual orientation. We aspire to have a diverse and inclusive workplace and strongly encourage suitably qualified applicants from a wide range of backgrounds to apply and join Discovery Educational Trust.

Discovery Educational Trust is committed to safeguarding our pupils against radicalisation and extremism and promoting the welfare of children and young people, and expects all staff and volunteers to share this commitment.

In compliance with safer recruitment procedures and guidelines, all applications must be made on an application form, CVs will not be accepted. It is an offence to apply for a role if barred from regulated activity. This appointment will be subject to pre-employment checks including an enhanced disclosure from the Disclosure and Barring Service and satisfactory references. Please note that online checks will also be carried out.

We welcome prospective applicants to arrange either a visit to the school/trust, or an informal telephone conversation, prior to submitting an application. This is a great opportunity to learn more about the role and our school community. Please email us to arrange (recruitment@discoveryeducationaltrust.co.uk).

title: MSP Mac Help Desk Guru (work from home)
description:
Headquarters: ignitionit.com

 URL: https://ignitionit.com

 Fully Remote · Work from home · Full-time (Eastern or Pacific time zones) · Apple-first

 TL;DR

 ignitionit.com is a seasoned, Apple-first MSP — in business for almost 30 years — and we're hiring a Help Desk Technician to be the friendly, capable first voice our clients reach when something isn't working. This position is a remote, work-from-home, full-time role.

 We've written this as a junior-to-mid-level job description because that's where most great people start on our team. But if you're more seasoned — comfortable in identity, MDM, or security work — don't scroll past. We'd be delighted to find someone who can step in higher up the ladder, and we'll happily talk about a more senior scope and comp if that's you.

 What the actual job???

 Unlike many IT shops, we believe that the technology is the tactic. The actual job is making people feel taken care of. One of our core values is “49% tech support, 51% human support.”

 You'll succeed by configuring devices, resetting access, untangling email, and chasing down the gremlin that's been haunting someone's conference room. But you'll know you succeeded when a client exhales and says, “Thank goodness you're on it!” That Warm Fuzzy Feeling™ is the actual product. The green lights on the dashboard are just how we get there.

 In a typical week, you might:

•
 Onboard a new hire at a fast-growing startup: provision their Mac, set up their Google Workspace or Microsoft 365 accounts, enroll the device in MDM, and make sure day one feels effortless.

•
 Offboard a departing employee cleanly — recover the laptop, revoke access, and close the loop so nothing's left dangling. All boxes checked, ticket notated and closed, client followed up with.

•
 Field a "my email stopped working" ticket that turns out to be a DNS thing, a phishing-filter thing, or a "they changed their password on their phone three weeks ago" thing.

•
 Help a family office or RIA get a touchy Zoom Room or conference-room AV setup behaving before a meeting — over the phone.

•
 Triage the queue so phones get answered fast, emails don't rot, and nobody feels forgotten — even when the honest answer is, “We're on it, but here's the realistic timeline."

 ⠀ You'll be the front line: helping with what you can, researching what you can't, and pinging the rest of the team when you're genuinely stuck. That last part is a skill, not a weakness — knowing when to ask is half the job.

 About ignitionit.com

 We're one of the oldest Apple Technical Partners on the planet, and one of the only certified Apple Premier Partners — that’s kinda like getting knighted by the ghost of Steve Jobs. We started where you’d expect to find Macs (creative agencies, non-profits, education) but our primary clients today are cutting-edge, venture-backed AI SaaS startups, VC and private equity firms, registered investment advisors — many of them operating under stringent compliance expectations (SOC 2, SEC). That means we hold ourselves to a higher standard than the scrappy shop we started as. Polished, reliable, security-minded work is the baseline now — but always with a smile!

 What hasn't changed: relationships are still our most valuable currency — with clients, with vendors, and with each other. We're a tight, supportive team. We teach each other what we know, cover for each other when life throws a punch, and care a little too much about doing things the right way. We're still a bit weird, and our clients seem to like us that way.

 We move fast, priorities shift, it’s not always documented (whatever it is), our tool set and list of supported platforms is sprawling, and some days the to-do list is longer than you'd like. If you can stay warm under pressure, create order out of chaos, learn new stuff fast because you love it, and speak up when you need help, you'll thrive here.

 If you need a rigid, fully-documented, never-changes environment where nobody trusts you with admin access, where you will be micro-managed so you never have to wonder whether or not you’re doing the right thing, this isn't it. You’ll have a ton of independence on our team, and freedom to use your best judgment to get the ball over the finish line, but that also means we expect you to be naturally responsible, honest, and highly accountable — to yourself, your teammates, and the clients. As they say, the price of freedom is eternal vigilance.

 The tech you'll work with (and grow into)

 Day one, you'll be living in:

•
 Apple at the core — macOS, iOS, Apple Business Manager, and MDM (Jamf / Iru / Intune / Workspace ONE / and more)

•
 Yes, PCs too — about one-third of our users are driving Windows

•
 Google Workspace and Microsoft 365 admin consoles

•
 Identity and access — SSO, MFA, and security keys (Okta, Entra ID, Yubikey, and friends)

•
 Lots of other security tools — our stack is constantly evolving and may vary from client to client

•
 The everyday productivity stack — Slack, Zoom, conference-room AV, networking basics (Meraki), and endpoint tooling

 ⠀ You don't need to know all of this. You need to be the kind of person who wants to. As you grow, there's a clear path into infrastructure administration, project architecture and implementation, and — for the right person — security and compliance work (phishing simulations, endpoint detection, SOC 2 / CIS / SEC readiness, due diligence questionnaire support, etc.). That's where our most senior people live, and it's wide open.

 Who we hope you are

 The hard requirements — we won't move forward unless you:

•
 Can work standard business hours in Eastern or Pacific time zones (we currently need both)

•
 Have a quiet home workspace and reliable broadband

•
 Have proven Apple aptitude — you actually use and like the Apple ecosystem

•
 Have at least 5 years of IT support experience on the job.

 ⠀ Everything else — and this is the longer list, on purpose. We figure technical skills are teachable; character takes a lot longer. So we're looking for someone who:

•
 Genuinely cares — about clients, teammates, and doing right by people

•
 Loves to learn, and proves it in how they spend their time

•
 Reads, and writes clearly — clear writing is clear thinking, and you'll do a lot of it

•
 Stays calm and kind with a frustrated person on the other end of the line

•
 Can tell the difference between good customer service and fantastic customer service, and refuses to settle for the former

•
 Notices when something's being done inefficiently and fixes it (you may boast about it later, that’s fine)

•
 Proofreads their own work (yes, we noticed whether you proofread your application)

•
 Has a sense of humor, and doesn't take themselves too seriously

 Regarding AI

 Our company founder/CEO is headquartered in the Bay Area. We work with innovative, ambitious companies developing AI products. Our team members hold a range of opinions about whether AI is “good or bad” for humans, but at the end of the day, we embrace the plain fact that it is here, we must embrace it to evolve, and our clients increasingly depend on us to help them embrace it, too, to help them evolve and stay competitive.

 Our CEO's opinion: AI will not replace human labor any time soon; rather, AI is a new opportunity to either (a) get things done faster, or (b) get a much higher quality of output than before. If you’re an AI tinkerer, great! We want to hear how you’re using it and see your latest vibe project. If you’re allergic to AI or have no interest in learning new habits to work effectively with it, this is not the place for you.

 Compensation & logistics

•
 Base salary: Applicants outside the USA will be compensated according to your local employment market. For applicants closer to the junior side who are located in the USA, $50,000–$65,000/yr, depending on experience level and your local geographical price index. With experience, comp goes up from there. Genuinely experienced, more senior candidates can be slotted higher — let's talk.

•
 Type & location: Full-time, work from home, fully remote. Eastern or Pacific time zones.

•
 Benefits: Medical / dental / vision for the employee, 401(k) with employer contribution, 2 weeks of PTO annually to start, and a stipend for your home internet.

 How to apply

 The first step is really easy and only takes 10 minutes — no resume, no cover letter, no essays. Here's how:

•
 Take this online Culture Index assessment (about 10 minutes): We use it to screen for people whose natural wiring fits how our team works.

•
 If your profile lines up with what we're looking for, we'll reach out and ask you to complete a 60-minute TestGorilla assessment for critical thinking skills, send us your resume, and maybe a couple of other items.

•
 From there, we conduct between 2-4 video interviews. One of these might be a live technical assessment.

 If the Culture Index step feels like a strange way to start a job application — that's kind of the point. Remember the phrase Think Different?

 Ignition is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome and will consider all qualified applicants. Good luck in your search — and may the Force be with you!

 To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/ignition-inc-msp-mac-help-desk-guru-work-from-home

title: Tutor - Vocal Studies & Industry Insights (Leeds Junior Conservatoire)
location: Leeds, Yorkshire and the Humber, GB
description:
About the Role

4 hours on Saturday (term time only)

Leeds Junior Conservatoire is recruiting for a Tutor - Vocal studies & industry insights

We are looking for an enthusiastic musician-educator to work across a range of classes including Music Theory & Practical Musicianship, Leeds Junior Conservatoire Experience Band and Composition, helping students to deepen their understanding of music whilst developing their creativity, collaborative skills and musical confidence.

Leeds Junior Conservatoire (LJC) is a thriving community of young musicians, creators and performers from across Yorkshire and the North, offering exceptional opportunities for students aged 8–18 to develop their musical skills and creativity.

At LJC, we foster an inclusive, supportive environment where every young person can thrive. As part of our collaborative team of passionate educators and industry professionals, you will help nurture artistic ambition, self-expression and a lifelong love of music.

(Hourly rate is inclusive of prep time and holiday pay)

What You Will Do

As part of this role, you will teach across four areas of our programme:

Vocal Skills

Develop students' core singing technique through work on breath control, vocal health, tone production, musicianship, stylistic awareness and performance confidence. Students explore a variety of contemporary and commercial repertoire while building strong vocal foundations.

Musical Theatre Singing

Support students to develop the specialist skills required for musical theatre performance, combining vocal technique with storytelling, interpretation, characterisation and stagecraft. Students explore repertoire from a range of musical theatre styles and eras.

Advanced Vocals

Work with experienced and committed young singers to refine advanced vocal technique, artistry and performance practice. Students are encouraged to develop their own artistic identity, interpret challenging repertoire and prepare for future musical study and performance opportunities.

Industry Insights

Introduce students to the wide range of careers and opportunities within the music and performing arts industries. Through discussion, practical activities and guest insights where appropriate, students gain a greater understanding of the skills, pathways and professional expectations of working as a contemporary artist, vocalist or performer.

This is a fantastic opportunity for a practitioner who is passionate about vocal education and helping young people discover their creative potential through singing and performance.

You will:

  • Deliver engaging, inclusive and differentiated teaching for students aged 8–18, fostering creativity, confidence and musical independence.

  • Monitor student progress, provide constructive feedback, and contribute to curriculum development, assessment and teaching administration.

  • Collaborate with colleagues to support student success, maintain high teaching standards, and contribute to performances, open days and other LJC events.

About You

  • A degree in Music, Vocal Performance, Musical Theatre, Music Education or a related subject, with expertise in vocal performance and vocal pedagogy.
  • Experience teaching or working with young people under 18, including students of mixed abilities and those with special educational needs and disabilities (SEND).
  • Strong communication, organisation and classroom management skills, with the ability to facilitate engaging group learning and performance activities.
  • A commitment to inclusive music and performing arts education, ensuring all students can participate, develop their skills and achieve their potential.
  • A commitment to safeguarding young people and promoting equality, diversity and inclusion.
  • Availability to work on Saturdays during term time.
  • Desirable - Professional experience as a vocalist, musical theatre performer, vocal coach or music educator, including experience preparing students for auditions, performances or progression to further musical study, supported by a recognised teaching qualification, relevant continuing professional development, or current knowledge of the music and performing arts industries.


Any offer of employment will be made subject to an enhanced DBS check, which will be sought by the LJC for the successful applicant.

title: Student Welfare Officer
location: Leeds, Yorkshire and the Humber, GB
description:
About the Role

We are looking for a dedicated and compassionate Student Welfare Officer to join our team at Leeds City College in the Adult & Community department. In this role, you will provide essential advice, guidance and practical support to students experiencing financial hardship, housing difficulties and other welfare challenges that may affect their ability to access and succeed in education.

You will manage applications for financial assistance through the Learning Support Fund, support students with complex welfare needs, and work closely with curriculum, pastoral and SEND teams to ensure appropriate support is in place. You will also develop and deliver welfare awareness activities, build relationships with external support agencies, and monitor the impact of interventions on student attendance, achievement and progression. This is an opportunity to make a meaningful difference to students' lives by helping them overcome barriers to learning and achieve their potential.

What You Will Do

  • Provide welfare advice and practical support to students facing financial, housing and personal difficulties.

  • Manage the Learning Support Fund, including applications for travel, meals and equipment.

  • Support vulnerable students and manage complex welfare cases.

  • Work with pastoral, curriculum and SEND teams to remove barriers to learning.

  • Refer students to external agencies and specialist support services.

  • Deliver welfare awareness activities and information sessions.

  • Monitor student attendance, progress and the impact of welfare interventions.

  • Maintain accurate records and promote student wellbeing, safeguarding and inclusion.

About You

We are looking for someone who is compassionate, approachable and committed to helping students overcome barriers to education. You will have:

  • Level 2 qualifications in English and maths.

  • A degree or equivalent higher-level qualification, or a relevant professional qualification with substantial experience.

  • A Level 4 qualification in advice or support work, such as Information, Advice and Guidance (IAG), or substantial experience in providing advice.

  • Significant experience supporting vulnerable students, including SEND learners and those experiencing financial hardship.

  • Strong knowledge of student finance, funding, welfare support and barriers to learning.

  • Experience working with external agencies and referring individuals to specialist services.

  • Excellent communication, listening and interpersonal skills, with an empathetic and non-judgemental approach.

  • Strong organisational and IT skills, including managing caseloads, maintaining records and monitoring interventions.

  • A commitment to safeguarding, equality, diversity, inclusion and restorative practice.

and initiatives. You will also be helping to build the culture of philanthropy across the RLT community,

managing resources, administration, and communications across the network.

our principles.

Our employees benefit from a wide variety of support including extensive continuing professional learning

title: Cleaner
description:
We are recruiting a school cleaner to join our professional site team. We are looking for a reliable and conscientious colleague, who will take pride in the appearance of the school and provide a clean and tidy environment for our students, staff and lettings.

Experience in school cleaning is useful but not essential and using cleaning machines and cleaning products would be an advantage, although training will be provided for the successful applicant. Common sense and the ability to be self-motivated is essential. You will need to work as part of a team under the direction of the Cleaning Manager.

  4. Wiping of skirting boards and walls daily.
  5. Collection and disposal of rubbish to designated areas.
  6. Maintain clean toilets to ensure hygiene standards are met. Mop floors daily.
  7. Ensure grounds are kept free from rubbish and debris so a clean and tidy site is maintained at all times.
  8. To replenish hand towels, hand soap and toilet roll as required.
  9. Report any premises or equipment defects to a senior caretaker.
  10. Undertake, if working during School Holiday shutdowns, a complete “deep clean” of all areas. Including window cleaning, moving furniture to clean, behind radiators, outside areas etc.

Please complete the application form to apply for the position.

In addition to providing the highest standards of teaching and learning, the priority of the Academy is the safety and welfare of its students. Therefore all staff undergo an enhanced DBS investigation and full references will be taken.

 Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com .

 Team Description

 The Brand Ad Formats team drives the development of ad formats that help advertisers maximize reach and brand impact. They focus on high-visibility, awareness-driven solutions that create memorable experiences for Reddit users. By delivering guaranteed placements and engaging ad interactions, they support major brand initiatives and help advertisers achieve measurable outcomes. The team is building fully customizable interactive formats and AI-driven ads that incorporate User-Generated Content (UGC). description:
Headquarters: Remote - United States

 Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com .

 Who We Are:

 The Knowledge Graph Platform team builds the foundational systems that help Reddit understand entities, relationships, and context across its content. We are evolving an advanced, AI-powered knowledge graph into a reliable, scalable platform that enables teams across Reddit to build better experiences on top of shared, high-quality knowledge.

 This is a high-leverage team at the intersection of data, platform engineering, and AI. Our work supports emerging capabilities such as contextual grounding while creating the contracts, standards, and developer experience that make shared data dependable and easy to use. This team is strategically positioned to impact both ads and consumer roadmaps. Our data is used across ads marketplace models as well as user-facing features on reddit.com .

 What You’ll Do:

• Lead, coach, and develop a team of engineers building Reddit’s Knowledge Graph Platform; create a high-trust, high-performing environment with clear goals and strong technical ownership.

• Set the technical direction and roadmap for a scalable knowledge graph platform, including data and API contracts, service interfaces, reliability, observability, performance, and developer experience.

• Leverage SOTA LLM and agentic patterns for knowledge graph construction.

• Establish production-grade operating standards: defining SLOs, implementing quality measures of data within the knowledge graph, governance mechanisms, and safe change-management practices.

• Partner with engineering, computational linguists, and domain-expert teams to define a shared operating model for ontology, data quality, governance, and platform evolution.

• Be a steward of data in the KG - ensure the graph has the coverage and freshness needed for priority use cases. Work with our dedicated data labeler team on shared goals around data coverage and quality.

• Work closely with internal product and engineering teams to understand their needs, prioritize high-value use cases, and increase access to the platform.

• Drive the next wave of graph-powered capabilities, including opportunities in shopping, search, ads marketplace models, consumer feed models.

• Stay close to architecture and technical design, helping the team navigate complex system tradeoffs and contribute hands-on when it is the highest-leverage path.

• Communicate the team’s strategy, priorities, risks, and progress clearly across a distributed, cross-functional organization.

• Experience with knowledge graphs, semantic or ontology systems, entity resolution, search, or contextual grounding is highly desired.

• Strong understanding of how to turn a technical system into a product-like platform: setting an operating model with customers, establishing data or service-level contracts, useful documentation, and a path to self-service adoption.

• Strong technical judgment across distributed systems, backend services, data platforms, APIs, reliability, and operational excellence.

 Ping Identity is seeking a strategic, commercially minded, and highly influential Director, Global Alliances – Accenture to own and accelerate our relationship with Accenture worldwide.

 This is a high-impact global leadership role—not a regional partner-management position. You will serve as Ping’s single accountable alliance leader for Accenture, shaping the global strategy, executive relationship, operating model, and joint go-to-market plan across Accenture’s Identity, Security, Technology, Song, industry, cloud, delivery, and managed-services organizations.

 The successful candidate will turn a complex global relationship into a focused, repeatable growth engine—aligning executives, mobilizing Ping’s teams, and helping Accenture make Ping the identity platform of choice in strategic transformation programs.

 This is a hands-on builder role. You will craft the strategy, create the operating model, and drive execution from executive alignment through customer outcomes. You will build top-down and bottoms-up engagement and convert shared priorities into strategic collaboration agreements, joint investment plans, and measurable results.

 What you will own

 Global alliance strategy and executive leadership

• Define and execute a multi-year global Accenture alliance strategy aligned to Ping’s corporate priorities, growth objectives, product strategy, and regional plans.

• Establish trusted relationships with Accenture’s global and regional executives across Identity, Cybersecurity, Technology, Song, cloud, industry, delivery, and managed services.

• Act as Ping’s primary global Accenture leadership point and orchestrate executive alignment when priorities, resources, commercial interests, or customer pursuits require senior intervention.

• Build and maintain a joint annual business plan with clear priorities, investments, owners, milestones, and measurable outcomes.

• Create a global-to-local operating model that gives AMER, EMEA, and APJ teams a common strategy while allowing appropriate regional and country-level activation.

• Drive GTM Acceleration, ensuring Ping is front-and-center with Accenture SAL’s and CAL’s across industry verticals.

 Strategic engagement and collaboration agreements

• Build a deliberate, multi-threaded engagement model with Accenture’s global leadership, practice executives, industry leaders, regional sponsors, account executives, and delivery leaders.

• Create executive alignment around a small number of strategic priorities, including the business case, mutual value, investment requirements, customer outcomes, and path to scale.

• Develop, advance, and operationalize strategic collaboration agreements, memoranda of understanding, annual business plans, and related partnership frameworks with Accenture.

• Translate agreements into clear gives-and-gets, governance structures, named owners, investment principles, milestones, escalation paths, and measurable success criteria.

• Partner with Ping Finance, Legal, Operations, Product, Sales, Sales Engineering, Professional Services, and executive leadership to ensure agreements are commercially sound, executable, and connected to Ping’s broader strategy.

• Establish a cadence of executive briefings, steering committees, business reviews, and working sessions that keeps both organizations aligned and accountable.

• Identify when a relationship should progress from informal collaboration to a formal strategic agreement, and lead the internal and partner process required to make that progression successful.

 Joint go-to-market and revenue growth

• Develop a disciplined joint go-to-market motion spanning “to,” “with,” and “through” Accenture partner routes.

• Build and manage a prioritized target-account strategy, including account mapping, install-base intelligence, whitespace analysis, opportunity hypotheses, and executive sponsorship.

• Mobilize Ping account teams and Accenture sales, account, industry, and practice leaders around qualified opportunities and strategic pursuits.

• Drive partner-sourced, partner-influenced, co-sell, resale, services-attach, and expansion revenue while establishing clear definitions for attribution and credit.

• Create repeatable joint offers and sales plays that connect Ping’s identity security platform with Accenture’s consulting, implementation, transformation, and managed-services capabilities.

• Improve pipeline quality, progression, forecast accuracy, win rates, deal velocity, and strategic account penetration through consistent inspection and action planning.

• Ensure that the partnership produces referenceable customer outcomes—not only activity, meetings, or enablement attendance.

 Governance, operating rhythm, and accountability

• Establish a practical governance model with executive sponsorship, a named steering committee, working teams, escalation paths, and clear decision rights.

• Lead monthly operating reviews, quarterly business reviews, and annual planning sessions with Ping and Accenture executives.

• Maintain a shared scorecard covering pipeline, bookings, revenue, services attach, target-account engagement, enablement, certifications, delivery capacity, joint offers, lighthouse customers, customer outcomes, and referenceability.

• Convert strategic intent into 30-, 60-, and 90-day execution plans with named owners and measurable milestones.

• Identify execution gaps early, make trade-offs explicit, and hold both organizations accountable for commitments.

• Partner with Finance, Legal, Operations, and leadership teams to establish sound commercial, investment, compliance, and reporting practices.

 Enablement, delivery, and customer success

• Work with the partner enablement team to build a scalable enablement strategy for Accenture sales, solution architects, consultants, and delivery professionals.

• Align Ping Professional Services, Customer Success, Sales Engineering, Product, Support, Enablement and other partner delivery resources to improve implementation quality, customer outcomes, and feedback loops.

• Connect enablement to pipeline, pursuits, implementations, services attach, and customer outcomes.

• Set targets, identify gaps, coordinate Ping resources, and report progress through alliance governance and quarterly business reviews.

 Cross-functional leadership inside Ping

• Serve as Accenture’s connective tissue between Global Alliances and Sales, Sales Engineering, Product, Product Marketing, Partner Marketing, Professional Services, Customer Success, Finance, Legal, and Operations.

• Create clarity on roles, resources, pursuit strategy, deal engagement, channel conflict, commercial guardrails, and escalation paths.

• Champion partner-led execution across Ping’s global field organization and make it easy for sellers to understand when and how to engage Accenture.

• Represent the voice of Accenture internally while protecting Ping’s strategic, customer, commercial, and operational interests.

• Build a culture of ownership, transparency, urgency, and measurable execution across the virtual alliance team.

 What success looks like

 Success will be measured by:

• An adopted global strategy, strong executive relationships, and effective governance.

• Strategic collaboration agreements with clear mutual commitments, investments, and outcomes.

• Growth in qualified pipeline, bookings, revenue, and services attach for both Ping and Accenture.

• A measurable Accenture enablement and delivery capability, supported by training, certifications, and capacity.

• Stronger field execution, forecast discipline, new logos, renewals and referenceable outcomes.

 What you bring

• Experience building and managing strategic relationships with Accenture, ideally across global or regional practices.

• Experience in cybersecurity; experience with identity is a strong plus.

• Experience building and scaling programs—from strategy and operating model through enablement, execution, and measurement.

• International experience working across regions, cultures, and complex global organizations.

• 12+ years of experience in channels, sales, or related fields

We are looking for a highly motivated individual who is organised and able to work autonomously and calmly under pressure, is able to communicate well with people of all ages and from all backgrounds, can demonstrate a positive and inclusive manner and is solution focused.

title: Salesforce Lead - USA
description:
Headquarters: Remote

 Storyblok is a headless CMS that enables marketers and developers to create with joy and publish with confidence. It empowers you to deliver structured and consistent content everywhere: websites, apps, AI search, and beyond.

 Legendary brands like Virgin Media O2, Oatly, and TomTom use Storyblok to make a bigger, faster market impact.

 WHAT IS IN IT FOR YOU

 You will be joining a growing company where you can contribute to many “firsts”. Plus these benefits:

• Monthly remote work stipend (home internet costs, electricity). Home office equipment package right at the start (laptop, keyboard, monitor…)

• Home office equipment upgrade (furniture, ear plugs …) or membership to a local co-working space after your onboarding

• Sick leave benefit, parental leave and 25 days of annual leave plus your local national holidays

• Personal development fund for courses, books, conferences, and material

• The annual international team-building trip, quarterly and monthly online get-togethers

• As a fully remote company, with work-life balance at its core, you’ll enjoy flexible schedules

• An international team that loves to have fun at work and works hard together to accomplish shared goals

 JOB SUMMARY

 Storyblok is hiring a Salesforce Lead to own Salesforce architecture, execution, governance, data quality, integrations, and release discipline across our GTM workflows. This techno-functional owner moves from business process to system design, build coordination, release control, data quality, reporting impact, and user adoption, owning Sales Cloud and core CRM objects, Pardot / Account Engagement, DealHub CPQ integration, lead-to-cash and quote-to-cash workflows, routing, campaign and lifecycle data, permissions, integrations, and documentation. The role also leads future platform evaluation for Salesforce Data 360, Salesforce Marketing Cloud Advanced, Adobe Marketing Cloud, Oracle Responsys, and related CDP needs, and, if a platform is selected, leads implementation planning and execution with RevOps, Marketing Operations, Data, Finance, Legal, vendors, and external partners.

 ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS

• Salesforce architecture and GTM systems governance

• Own Salesforce platform architecture across GTM workflows, objects, fields, permissions, automations, integrations, and release control.

• Translate RevOps, Marketing Operations, Sales, Customer Success, Finance, and Data requirements into clean system design and controlled execution.

• Maintain governance for new fields, objects, flows, validation rules, permission sets, integrations, reporting dependencies, and documentation.

• Sales Cloud and core CRM ownership

• Own system design for leads, contacts, accounts, opportunities, activities, campaigns, lifecycle stages, routing, renewals, expansions, and customer handoffs.

• Support lead-to-cash workflows with clear ownership, required fields, source logic, stage rules, assignment logic, and adoption checks.

• Monitor CRM completeness, data freshness, duplicates, routing failures, and workflow friction that creates manual workarounds.

• Pardot, Account Engagement, and marketing workflow support

• Partner with Marketing Operations on Pardot or Account Engagement, campaign data, lifecycle stages, scoring inputs, consent, routing, attribution support, and funnel reporting.

• Maintain the Salesforce-side architecture for marketing-to-sales handoffs, campaign member data, source fields, conversion logic, and reporting quality.

• Keep current marketing workflows stable while future marketing cloud and CDP options are evaluated.

• Future Data 360, SFMC Advanced, Adobe, Oracle, and CDP evaluation

• Lead the requirements, scorecard, architecture review, vendor comparison, data governance review, and implementation readiness plan for future customer data and marketing cloud decisions.

• Evaluate Salesforce Data 360, Salesforce Marketing Cloud Advanced, Adobe Marketing Cloud, Oracle Responsys, and related CDP needs against GTM use cases, data model, activation, consent, reporting, integration, cost, and operating complexity.

• If a platform is selected, lead implementation planning and execution with clear phases, owners, risks, testing, migration, enablement, and adoption metrics.

• DealHub CPQ integration, data quality, releases, and adoption

• Own Salesforce-side integration quality for DealHub CPQ, including quote data, approval sync, product lines, opportunity fields, order handoffs, and reporting impact.

• Run release management with intake, solution design, testing, regression checks, deployment, communication, documentation, and adoption tracking.

• Partner with Data on source-to-report logic so Salesforce, warehouse, Finance, and leadership reporting stay aligned.

 EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

• Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

• 6+ years in the Salesforce ecosystem, including hands-on administration and solution / architecture ownership in a GTM or Revenue Operations context.

• Salesforce certifications strongly preferred (e.g., Administrator, Advanced Administrator, Platform App Builder; Sales Cloud Consultant or Application Architect a plus).

• Hands-on experience with Sales Cloud, core CRM objects, declarative automation (Flow), permissions, and release / change management across environments.

• Experience with Pardot / Marketing Cloud Account Engagement and marketing-to-sales workflows, and with CPQ tools (DealHub or comparable) across lead-to-cash and quote-to-cash.

• Experience integrating Salesforce with downstream systems (data warehouse, Finance, marketing, order management) and supporting reporting and data quality.

• Familiarity with CDP / marketing cloud platform evaluation (e.g., Salesforce Data 360, SFMC Advanced, Adobe, Oracle Responsys) is a plus.

• Demonstrates AI literacy, with the ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, decision-making, and quality of work while applying sound judgment and critical thinking.

 PROFESSIONAL COMPETENCIES

• Systems thinking: translates cross-functional business requirements into clean, scalable system design and governance.

• Technical CRM depth: strong command of Salesforce architecture, data model, automation, permissions, and integrations.

• Release and change discipline: structured intake, testing, regression, deployment, documentation, and adoption tracking.

• Data quality and governance orientation: drives completeness, freshness, deduplication, and field control.

• Stakeholder management: partners effectively across RevOps, Marketing Operations, Sales, CS, Finance, Data, Legal, and vendors.

• Vendor and platform evaluation: builds requirements, scorecards, and implementation readiness plans for major platform decisions.

• Clear communication: explains what is being built, the decision needed, and the business outcome to technical and non-technical audiences.

• Bias for reliability: reduces defects, manual workarounds, and ambiguity through documentation and controlled execution.

 U.S. Base Salary Range: $102,900 - $140,000

 At Storyblok, we are committed to equitable compensation and pay transparency. We consider many factors when it comes to compensation, such as the scope of the role, job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Our base salary ranges are determined by job and job level and are benchmarked to relevant location and industry data. The range displayed represents the target US base compensation range within which we are hiring for this role. For some roles Storyblok also offers a competitive commission structure.

 MENTAL, PHYSICAL AND ENVIRONMENTAL REQUIREMENTS

 Remote (home) work opportunity or funded by Storyblok co-working space

 GENERAL TERMS

 Storyblok has a commitment to diversity and inclusion. We strive to create a hiring environment in which all people feel they are equally respected and valued, irrespective of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, ethnicity, age, religion, citizenship or any other characteristic. You can find more information about our privacy policy here .

 All communications regarding job opportunities at Storyblok will come from an official Storyblok employee with an email address ending in @storyblok.com. We will never redirect you to another portal or another site that is unrelated to our domain ( storyblok.com ).

Working as part of our wider Pastoral Team, you will be one of three Behaviour Support Officers, helping to promote positive behaviour, support student engagement and ensure a safe and supportive learning environment for all.

The role will involve a varied range of responsibilities, including managing our internal isolation room, supporting after-school detentions and assisting with behaviour interventions across the school, working closely with both students and staff.

The Role

  • Managing the isolation room and helping students reflect and reset to re-engage with learning.

  • Supporting students and staff during daily after-school detentions, ensuring students complete work in a structured environment.

  • Responding to behavioural incidents in classrooms and across the school site as part of the SLT call-out system.

  • Conducting investigations into behavioural issues and reporting to the Senior Leadership Team (SLT).

  • Rotating between managing the isolation room, providing call-out support, and assisting with behaviour interventions.

About You:

We are looking for individuals with strong interpersonal skills, patience, and the ability to remain calm under pressure. You should have experience working with young people, preferably in an educational setting, and the ability to build positive relationships with students, staff, and parents. A commitment to supporting students’ academic and personal development is essential.

Why Join Us?

At Furze Platt, we offer a supportive and friendly working environment with access to professional development opportunities. Staff benefits include access to an on-site gym, a comprehensive employee assistance program, and free on-site parking.

title: Assistant Educational Psychologist
description:
Be part of something ambitious. Help every child thrive

Bridge Academy Trust (BAT) is seeking to appoint a 2 year fixed term Assistant Educational Psychologist to join our expanding Inclusion offer. This is a rare opportunity to gain broad, purposeful experience across a family of highly collaborative schools that place inclusion, belonging and opportunity at the heart of everything they do. Working across primary, secondary and specialist resource base provision, you will play a key role in helping children and young people overcome barriers, develop confidence and achieve success.

You will contribute to the development of an innovative Trust wide model of psychological support, working alongside passionate and experienced school leaders. This is a genuine step towards doctoral training as an Educational Psychologist.

You will work under the professional supervision of a qualified Educational Psychologist, with dedicated CPD and supervision arrangements provided by Essex County Council, giving you the structure and support of a Local Authority EP service alongside the pace and variety of a multi-academy trust.

Why join us

  • Breadth of experience across primary, secondary and specialist resource base provision — rare for an Assistant EP post.
  • The opportunity to work alongside an exceptional network of experienced SENDCos and inclusion leaders.
  • Professional supervision and CPD provided by Essex County Council, alongside day-to-day support from the Trust.
  • A genuinely varied caseload: early intervention work, EHCNA-related assessment, small group intervention, and staff training.
  • The chance to help shape a Trust-wide model of psychological support from the ground up, working closely with school leaders and SENDCos.
  • A supportive, ambitious Trust with a strong track record of school improvement and inclusive practice.

You will be deployed flexibly across BAT's schools rather than fixed to a single site, working alongside qualified Educational Psychologists to:

  • Carry out targeted individual observation, advice and guidance to support in-school provision ahead of an Education, Health and Care Needs Assessment (EHCNA).
  • Undertake individual observation and write-up to support the EHCNA process, feeding into EP psychological advice.
  • Deliver small group intervention work directly with pupils.
  • Contribute to staff training on specific areas of development, such as adaptive teaching strategies for identified pupils or groups and to the development of evidence-based, best practice for inclusive provision.

About you:

  • A psychology degree (2:1 or above), an approved conversion course, or a Master's degree, AND eligibility for British Psychological Society (BPS) Graduate Basis for Chartered Membership (GBC).
  • Experience of working with children and young people in an education, care or family-oriented setting.
  • A genuine commitment to applying psychology to support children and young people with Special Educational Needs and/or Disabilities (SEND).
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with high personal and professional integrity.
  • A self-driven, reflective approach, with the confidence to work autonomously and know when to seek support.

Please read the job description before applying. A driving license and access to your own vehicle is essential for this role due to location changes.

Bridge Academy Trust may close this advert early if we receive a high volume of suitable applications.
